<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/csv.php';

const FAMILIES = ['Tapis de course', 'Vélos', 'Elliptiques & cardio', 'Rameurs', 'Musculation', 'Pilates & yoga',
    'Accessoires', 'Padel & raquettes', 'Loisirs', 'Bien-être & médical', 'Pièces & entretien', 'Autres'];

/* ---------- Produits ---------- */

/** Prix appliqué en caisse (promo si elle est inférieure au prix régulier). */
function product_price(array $p): int
{
    $promo = $p['promo_price'] ?? null;
    if ($promo !== null && (int)$promo > 0 && ((int)$promo < (int)$p['price'] || (int)$p['price'] === 0)) return (int)$promo;
    return (int)$p['price'];
}

function product_image(array $p): string
{
    if (!empty($p['image'])) return $p['image'];
    return $p['image_url'] ?? '';
}

/* ---------- Stock ---------- */

function stock_qty(int $productId, int $locationId): int
{
    return (int)(val('SELECT qty FROM stock WHERE product_id = ? AND location_id = ?', [$productId, $locationId]) ?? 0);
}

/** Ajoute $delta au stock et trace le mouvement. Retourne la nouvelle quantité. */
function stock_change(int $productId, int $locationId, int $delta, string $type, string $ref = '', string $note = ''): int
{
    q('INSERT INTO stock(product_id, location_id, qty) VALUES (?, ?, 0) ON CONFLICT(product_id, location_id) DO NOTHING', [$productId, $locationId]);
    q('UPDATE stock SET qty = qty + ? WHERE product_id = ? AND location_id = ?', [$delta, $productId, $locationId]);
    $after = stock_qty($productId, $locationId);
    insert('stock_moves', [
        'created_at' => now(), 'product_id' => $productId, 'location_id' => $locationId, 'qty_change' => $delta,
        'qty_after' => $after, 'type' => $type, 'ref' => $ref, 'note' => $note, 'user_id' => $_SESSION['uid'] ?? null,
    ]);
    return $after;
}

/** Fixe la quantité (inventaire). Retourne l'écart appliqué. */
function stock_set(int $productId, int $locationId, int $qty, string $type = 'inventaire', string $note = ''): int
{
    $delta = $qty - stock_qty($productId, $locationId);
    if ($delta !== 0) stock_change($productId, $locationId, $delta, $type, '', $note);
    return $delta;
}

/* ---------- Nettoyage des textes WooCommerce ---------- */

function clean_text(string $html): string
{
    $s = str_replace(['\\n', '\\r'], ["\n", ''], $html);
    $s = preg_replace('/\[video[^\]]*\](\[\/video\])?/i', '', $s);
    $s = preg_replace('/\[\/?[a-z_]+[^\]]*\]/i', '', $s);
    $s = preg_replace('/<!--.*?-->/s', '', $s);
    $s = preg_replace('#<img\b[^>]*>#i', '', $s);
    $s = preg_replace('#<li\b[^>]*>#i', "\n• ", $s);
    $s = preg_replace('#</t[dh]>\s*<t[dh]\b[^>]*>#i', ' : ', $s);
    $s = preg_replace('#<(br|/p|/li|/h\d|/div|/tr|/ul|/ol|/blockquote|/section)\b[^>]*>#i', "\n", $s);
    $s = strip_tags($s);
    $s = html_entity_decode($s, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8');
    $s = preg_replace('/[\x{2066}-\x{2069}\x{FFFC}\x{200B}\x{FEFF}]/u', '', $s);
    $s = str_replace("\u{00A0}", ' ', $s);
    $out = [];
    foreach (preg_split('/\R/u', $s) as $line) {
        $line = trim(preg_replace('/[ \t]+/u', ' ', $line));
        if ($line === '•' || $line === "'-") $line = '';
        if (preg_match('/^Si tu veux, je peux aussi/i', $line)) continue;
        if ($line === '' && (empty($out) || end($out) === '')) continue;
        $out[] = $line;
    }
    while ($out && end($out) === '') array_pop($out);
    // pas de ligne vide entre deux puces
    $res = [];
    foreach ($out as $i => $line) {
        if ($line === '' && isset($out[$i - 1], $out[$i + 1]) && str_starts_with($out[$i - 1], '•') && str_starts_with($out[$i + 1], '•')) continue;
        $res[] = $line;
    }
    return implode("\n", $res);
}

function guess_family(string $cats, string $name): string
{
    $c = mb_strtolower($cats);
    $t = mb_strtolower($cats . ' ' . $name);
    if (preg_match('/pi[eè]ces de rechange|bande tapis|cle de securite|clé de sécurité|huile lubrifiant/u', $t)) return 'Pièces & entretien';
    if (preg_match('/tapis roulant|treadmill/u', $t)) return 'Tapis de course';
    if (preg_match('/ellipti|ellepti|climber/u', $t)) return 'Elliptiques & cardio';
    if (preg_match('/rameur|ski ?erg/u', $t)) return 'Rameurs';
    if (preg_match('/v[ée]lo|bike|spinning|biking|vtt/u', $t)) return 'Vélos';
    if (preg_match('/\bpilates\b|reformer|yoga/u', $t)) return 'Pilates & yoga';
    if (preg_match('/padel|ping ?pong|raquette/u', $t)) return 'Padel & raquettes';
    if (preg_match('/m[ée]dical|massage/u', $t)) return 'Bien-être & médical';
    if (preg_match('/skate|trampoline|balance board/u', $c)) return 'Loisirs';
    if (preg_match('/musculation|\bbanc\b|bench|machine|multifonction|multi exercice|leg |smith|station|halt[eè]re|dumbbell|trx|barre|crunch|curl|pec fly/u', $t)) return 'Musculation';
    return 'Accessoires';
}

function guess_brand(string $name, string $short): string
{
    $s = trim($short);
    if (preg_match('/^(SVELTUS|CARE|CORNILLEAU|CUBE|AWAII|ARK-ONE|ATHLI-TECK)$/i', $s, $m)) return mb_strtoupper($m[1]);
    $t = $name . ' ' . mb_substr($s, 0, 400);
    $rules = [
        '/body sculpture/i' => 'Body Sculpture', '/nordi[ck]tra[c]?k/i' => 'NordicTrack', '/impulse/i' => 'Impulse',
        '/pro[- ]?form/i' => 'ProForm', '/hit ?up/i' => 'Hit Up Sport', '/bab-?dida/i' => 'Bab-Dida', '/avon fitness/i' => 'Avon Fitness',
        '/bullpadel/i' => 'Bullpadel', '/babolat/i' => 'Babolat', '/\bBT\b|bt fitness/' => 'BT Fitness', '/\bCARE\b/' => 'CARE',
    ];
    foreach ($rules as $re => $b) if (preg_match($re, $t)) return $b;
    return '';
}

function guess_warranty(string $text): ?int
{
    if (preg_match('/garantie\s*:?\s*(\d{1,2})\s*ans?\b/iu', $text, $m)) return (int)$m[1] * 12;
    return null;
}

/* ---------- Import ---------- */

/**
 * Importe une ligne produit, au format WooCommerce (export du site) ou au format de l'ERP.
 * $r : ligne aux en-têtes normalisés (slug_key). $opts : stock_location (int|null), mode ('woo'|'erp').
 */
function product_import_row(array $r, array $opts): string
{
    $woo = ($opts['mode'] ?? '') === 'woo';
    $g = function (string ...$keys) use ($r): string {
        foreach ($keys as $k) if (isset($r[$k]) && trim((string)$r[$k]) !== '') return trim((string)$r[$k]);
        return '';
    };

    if ($woo) {
        $type = $g('type');
        if ($type !== '' && !in_array($type, ['simple', 'variable', 'variation', 'external', 'grouped'], true)) return 'skipped';
        $short = clean_text($g('description_courte'));
        $long = clean_text($g('description'));
        $name = trim(preg_replace('/\s+/u', ' ', $g('nom')));
        if ($name === '') $name = mb_substr(strtok($short ?: '', "\n") ?: '', 0, 80);
        if ($name === '') return 'skipped';
        $brand = $g('marques') ?: guess_brand($name, $short);
        $desc = mb_strlen($short) >= 40 ? $short : ($long ?: $short);
        if (mb_strtoupper($desc) === mb_strtoupper($brand)) $desc = '';
        $published = $g('publie');
        $regular = parse_money($g('tarif_regulier'));
        $promo = parse_money($g('tarif_promo'));
        $images = array_values(array_filter(array_map('trim', explode(',', $g('images')))));
        $wooId = parse_int($g('id'));
        $local = $wooId && is_file(APP_ROOT . "/assets/img/products/$wooId.jpg") ? "assets/img/products/$wooId.jpg" : '';
        $cats = $g('categories');
        $data = [
            'woo_id' => $wooId,
            'sku' => $g('ugs'),
            'barcode' => $g('gtin_upc_ean_ou_isbn'),
            'name' => $name,
            'categories' => $cats,
            'price' => $regular ?? ($promo ?? 0),
            'promo_price' => ($promo !== null && $regular !== null && $promo < $regular) ? $promo : null,
            'description' => mb_substr($desc, 0, 3000),
            'image_url' => $images[0] ?? '',
            'web_status' => $published === '1' ? 'publie' : ($published === '-1' ? 'brouillon' : 'prive'),
            'active' => $published === '-1' ? 0 : 1,
        ];
        $existing = $wooId ? one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE woo_id = ?', [$wooId]) : null;
        if (!$existing && $data['sku'] !== '') $existing = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE sku = ? AND woo_id IS NULL', [$data['sku']]);
        $minStock = parse_int($g('montant_de_stock_faible'));
        if ($existing) {
            if ($local && !$existing['image']) $data['image'] = $local;
            if (!$existing['brand'] && $brand) $data['brand'] = $brand;
            if (!$existing['warranty_months']) $data['warranty_months'] = guess_warranty($short . "\n" . $long);
            $data['updated_at'] = now();
            update('products', $data, 'id = ?', [$existing['id']]);
            return 'updated';
        }
        $data += [
            'family' => guess_family($cats, $name), 'brand' => $brand, 'image' => $local,
            'warranty_months' => guess_warranty($short . "\n" . $long), 'min_stock' => $minStock ?? 0,
            'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now(),
        ];
        $pid = insert('products', $data);
        $qty = parse_int($g('stock'));
        if ($qty !== null && $qty !== 0 && !empty($opts['stock_location'])) {
            stock_change($pid, (int)$opts['stock_location'], $qty, 'import', 'CSV site', 'Stock indiqué dans l’export du site');
        }
        return 'created';
    }

    // Format ERP (export de cette application) : $r est indexé par les clés du jeu de données « produits »
    $name = $g('name');
    if ($name === '') throw new RuntimeException('Nom du produit manquant');
    $id = parse_int($g('id'));
    $wooId = parse_int($g('woo_id'));
    $sku = $g('sku');
    $existing = $id ? one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [$id]) : null;
    if (!$existing && $wooId) $existing = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE woo_id = ?', [$wooId]);
    if (!$existing && $sku !== '') $existing = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE sku = ?', [$sku]);
    $price = parse_money($g('price'));
    $family = $g('family');
    if ($family !== '' && !in_array($family, FAMILIES, true)) {
        foreach (FAMILIES as $f) if (slug_key($f) === slug_key($family)) $family = $f;
    }
    $active = $g('active');
    $data = ['name' => $name];
    foreach (['sku', 'barcode', 'brand', 'categories', 'description', 'image_url'] as $k) {
        if (array_key_exists($k, $r)) $data[$k] = $g($k);
    }
    if ($family !== '') $data['family'] = $family;
    if ($price !== null) $data['price'] = $price;
    if (array_key_exists('promo_price', $r)) $data['promo_price'] = parse_money($g('promo_price'));
    if (array_key_exists('cost', $r) && ($opts['can_cost'] ?? false)) $data['cost'] = parse_money($g('cost'));
    if (($w = parse_int($g('warranty_months'))) !== null) $data['warranty_months'] = $w;
    if (($ms = parse_int($g('min_stock'))) !== null) $data['min_stock'] = $ms;
    if ($active !== '') $data['active'] = in_array(mb_strtolower($active), ['1', 'oui', 'yes', 'true', 'actif', 'o'], true) ? 1 : 0;
    if ($wooId) $data['woo_id'] = $wooId;
    $data['updated_at'] = now();
    if ($existing) {
        update('products', $data, 'id = ?', [$existing['id']]);
        return 'updated';
    }
    if ($price === null) throw new RuntimeException('Prix de vente manquant pour « ' . $name . ' »');
    $data += ['family' => guess_family($data['categories'] ?? '', $name), 'created_at' => now()];
    insert('products', $data);
    return 'created';
}

/** Import initial (installation) du fichier exporté depuis WooCommerce. */
function catalog_import_woo_file(PDO $pdo, string $file): array
{
    $csv = csv_read_file($file);
    $count = ['created' => 0, 'updated' => 0, 'skipped' => 0];
    $dep = (int)(val("SELECT id FROM locations WHERE code = 'DEP'") ?? 0);
    foreach ($csv['rows'] as $row) {
        $res = product_import_row($row, ['mode' => 'woo', 'stock_location' => $dep ?: null]);
        $count[$res]++;
    }
    return $count;
}

function csv_is_woo(array $headers): bool
{
    return in_array('tarif_regulier', $headers, true) || in_array('ugs', $headers, true);
}

declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Lit un fichier CSV (UTF-8 ou Windows-1252, séparateur ; , ou tabulation détecté automatiquement).
 * Retourne ['headers' => [clés normalisées], 'labels' => [en-têtes d'origine], 'rows' => [[clé => valeur]], 'delimiter' => ...].
 */
function csv_read_file(string $file): array
{
    // Un classeur Excel (.xlsx) est lu directement : première feuille, première ligne = en-têtes.
    require_once __DIR__ . '/xlsx.php';
    if (xlsx_is_file($file)) return xlsx_as_csv($file);
    $raw = (string)file_get_contents($file);
    if (strncmp($raw, "\xEF\xBB\xBF", 3) === 0) $raw = substr($raw, 3);
    if (!mb_check_encoding($raw, 'UTF-8')) $raw = mb_convert_encoding($raw, 'UTF-8', 'Windows-1252');
    $firstLine = strtok($raw, "\n") ?: '';
    $counts = [';' => substr_count($firstLine, ';'), ',' => substr_count($firstLine, ','), "\t" => substr_count($firstLine, "\t")];
    arsort($counts);
    $delim = (string)array_key_first($counts);

    $fh = fopen('php://temp', 'r+');
    fwrite($fh, $raw);
    rewind($fh);
    $labels = fgetcsv($fh, 0, $delim, '"', '') ?: [];
    $labels = array_map(fn($h) => trim((string)$h), $labels);
    $headers = array_map('slug_key', $labels);
    $rows = [];
    $line = 1;
    while (($r = fgetcsv($fh, 0, $delim, '"', '')) !== false) {
        $line++;
        if ($r === [null] || (count($r) === 1 && trim((string)$r[0]) === '')) continue;
        $row = [];
        foreach ($headers as $i => $h) {
            if ($h === '') continue;
            $row[$h] = isset($r[$i]) ? (string)$r[$i] : '';
        }
        $row['__line'] = $line;
        $rows[] = $row;
    }
    fclose($fh);
    return ['headers' => $headers, 'labels' => $labels, 'rows' => $rows, 'delimiter' => $delim];
}

/** Envoie un CSV compatible Excel (UTF-8 avec BOM, séparateur point-virgule). */
function csv_send(string $filename, array $labels, iterable $rows): void
{
    header('Content-Type: text/csv; charset=utf-8');
    header('Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="' . $filename . '"');
    header('Cache-Control: no-store');
    $out = fopen('php://output', 'w');
    fwrite($out, "\xEF\xBB\xBF");
    fputcsv($out, $labels, ';', '"', '');
    foreach ($rows as $r) {
        fputcsv($out, array_map(fn($v) => is_null($v) ? '' : (string)$v, array_values($r)), ';', '"', '');
    }
    fclose($out);
    exit;
}

/** Montant pour un CSV : 1999,000 (virgule décimale, lisible par Excel en français). */
function csv_money($m): string
{
    return $m === null || $m === '' ? '' : number_format(((int)$m) / 1000, 3, ',', '');
}

function csv_bool($v): string
{
    return $v ? 'oui' : 'non';
}

function csv_yes($v): bool
{
    return in_array(mb_strtolower(trim((string)$v)), ['1', 'oui', 'o', 'yes', 'y', 'true', 'vrai', 'x'], true);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/*
 * Jeux de données importables / exportables en CSV.
 * Chaque entrée : label, help, export (permission ou liste), import (permission|null),
 * cols (clé => en-tête), rows(filtres) => itérable, import_row(ligne, options) => created|updated|skipped.
 */

function loc_from_text(string $s): ?int
{
    $s = trim($s);
    if ($s === '') return null;
    foreach (locations(false) as $l) {
        if (strcasecmp($l['code'], $s) === 0 || slug_key($l['name']) === slug_key($s) || (string)$l['id'] === $s) return (int)$l['id'];
    }
    throw new RuntimeException("Site « $s » inconnu (codes : " . implode(', ', array_column(locations(false), 'code')) . ').');
}

function user_from_text(string $s): ?int
{
    $s = trim($s);
    if ($s === '') return null;
    $id = val('SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ? OR name = ? COLLATE NOCASE', [$s, $s]);
    return $id ? (int)$id : null;
}

function key_from_label(array $map, string $s, string $default): string
{
    $s = trim($s);
    if ($s === '') return $default;
    if (isset($map[$s])) return $s;
    foreach ($map as $k => $label) if (slug_key($label) === slug_key($s) || slug_key($k) === slug_key($s)) return $k;
    return $default;
}

function product_from_row(array $r): ?array
{
    if (($id = parse_int($r['id'] ?? '')) && ($p = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [$id]))) return $p;
    if (($wid = parse_int($r['woo_id'] ?? '')) && ($p = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE woo_id = ?', [$wid]))) return $p;
    if (trim($r['sku'] ?? '') !== '' && ($p = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE sku = ?', [trim($r['sku'])]))) return $p;
    if (trim($r['name'] ?? '') !== '' && ($p = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE name = ? COLLATE NOCASE', [trim($r['name'])]))) return $p;
    return null;
}

function export_scope(array $f): ?int
{
    $s = scope_loc();
    return $s ?? ((int)($f['loc'] ?? 0) ?: null);
}

function datasets(): array
{
    static $ds = null;
    if ($ds) return $ds;
    $locs = locations(false);

    $ds['produits'] = [
        'label' => 'Produits (catalogue)', 'icon' => 'box', 'export' => 'products.export', 'import' => 'products.import',
        'help' => 'Accepte l’export WooCommerce du site (wc-product-export…csv) ou ce format. Correspondance par ID, ID site, référence (UGS).',
        'cols' => ['id' => 'ID', 'woo_id' => 'ID site', 'sku' => 'Référence', 'barcode' => 'Code-barres', 'name' => 'Nom', 'family' => 'Famille',
            'brand' => 'Marque', 'price' => 'Prix de vente', 'promo_price' => 'Prix promo', 'cost' => 'Prix d’achat', 'warranty_months' => 'Garantie (mois)',
            'min_stock' => 'Stock minimum', 'active' => 'Actif', 'stock_total' => 'Stock total', 'categories' => 'Catégories site',
            'description' => 'Description', 'image_url' => 'Image (URL)'],
        'rows' => function (array $f) {
            $admin = is_admin();
            foreach (all('SELECT p.*, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(qty) FROM stock WHERE product_id = p.id),0) st FROM products p ORDER BY p.family, p.name COLLATE NOCASE') as $p) {
                yield [$p['id'], $p['woo_id'], $p['sku'], $p['barcode'], $p['name'], $p['family'], $p['brand'], csv_money($p['price']),
                    csv_money($p['promo_price']), $admin ? csv_money($p['cost']) : '', $p['warranty_months'], $p['min_stock'], csv_bool($p['active']),
                    $p['st'], $p['categories'], $p['description'], $p['image_url'] ?: $p['image']];
            }
        },
        'import_row' => function (array $r, array $o) {
            if (!$o['woo'] && !is_admin()) unset($r['cost']);
            return product_import_row($r, ['mode' => $o['woo'] ? 'woo' : 'erp', 'stock_location' => $o['stock_location'] ?? null, 'can_cost' => is_admin()]);
        },
    ];

    $stockCols = ['id' => 'ID', 'sku' => 'Référence', 'name' => 'Nom', 'family' => 'Famille'];
    foreach ($locs as $l) $stockCols['loc_' . strtolower($l['code'])] = 'Stock ' . $l['code'];
    $stockCols += ['total' => 'Total', 'location' => 'Emplacement', 'qty' => 'Quantité'];
    $ds['stock'] = [
        'label' => 'Stock par emplacement', 'icon' => 'stock', 'export' => 'stock.export', 'import' => 'stock.import',
        'help' => 'Deux formats : une colonne « Stock TUN / Stock NAB / Stock DEP » par site, ou les colonnes « Emplacement » + « Quantité ». Produit reconnu par ID, référence ou nom exact.',
        'cols' => $stockCols,
        'rows' => function (array $f) use ($locs) {
            $by = [];
            foreach (all('SELECT product_id, location_id, qty FROM stock') as $s) $by[$s['product_id']][$s['location_id']] = (int)$s['qty'];
            foreach (all('SELECT id, sku, name, family FROM products WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY family, name COLLATE NOCASE') as $p) {
                $row = [$p['id'], $p['sku'], $p['name'], $p['family']];
                $tot = 0;
                foreach ($locs as $l) { $q = $by[$p['id']][$l['id']] ?? 0; $row[] = $q; $tot += $q; }
                $row[] = $tot;
                $row[] = '';
                $row[] = '';
                yield $row;
            }
        },
        'import_row' => function (array $r, array $o) use ($locs) {
            $p = product_from_row($r);
            if (!$p) throw new RuntimeException('Produit introuvable (' . trim(($r['id'] ?? '') . ' ' . ($r['sku'] ?? '') . ' ' . ($r['name'] ?? '')) . ').');
            $add = ($o['mode'] ?? 'set') === 'add';
            $done = false;
            $apply = function (int $loc, int $qty) use ($p, $add, &$done) {
                if ($add) { if ($qty !== 0) stock_change((int)$p['id'], $loc, $qty, 'entree', 'Import CSV'); }
                else stock_set((int)$p['id'], $loc, $qty, 'import', 'Import CSV (inventaire)');
                $done = true;
            };
            foreach ($locs as $l) {
                $k = 'loc_' . strtolower($l['code']);
                if (isset($r[$k]) && trim($r[$k]) !== '') {
                    $q = parse_int($r[$k]);
                    if ($q === null) throw new RuntimeException('Quantité invalide « ' . $r[$k] . ' ».');
                    $apply((int)$l['id'], $q);
                }
            }
            if (trim($r['qty'] ?? '') !== '') {
                $loc = loc_from_text($r['location'] ?? '') ?? ($o['location'] ?? null);
                if (!$loc) throw new RuntimeException('Emplacement manquant.');
                $q = parse_int($r['qty']);
                if ($q === null) throw new RuntimeException('Quantité invalide « ' . $r['qty'] . ' ».');
                $apply($loc, $q);
            }
            return $done ? 'updated' : 'skipped';
        },
    ];

    $ds['mouvements'] = [
        'label' => 'Mouvements de stock', 'icon' => 'transfer', 'export' => 'stock.export', 'import' => null, 'dates' => true,
        'help' => 'Historique des entrées, sorties, transferts, ventes et inventaires.',
        'cols' => ['date' => 'Date', 'product' => 'Produit', 'sku' => 'Référence', 'location' => 'Emplacement', 'type' => 'Type', 'qty' => 'Quantité', 'after' => 'Stock après', 'ref' => 'Référence mouvement', 'note' => 'Note', 'user' => 'Utilisateur'],
        'rows' => function (array $f) {
            foreach (all('SELECT m.*, p.name, p.sku, l.code, u.name un FROM stock_moves m JOIN products p ON p.id = m.product_id JOIN locations l ON l.id = m.location_id
                LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE date(m.created_at) BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY m.id', [$f['from'], $f['to']]) as $m) {
                yield [$m['created_at'], $m['name'], $m['sku'], $m['code'], MOVE_TYPES[$m['type']] ?? $m['type'], $m['qty_change'], $m['qty_after'], $m['ref'], $m['note'], $m['un']];
            }
        },
    ];

    $ds['ventes'] = [
        'label' => 'Ventes (détail des articles)', 'icon' => 'receipt', 'export' => ['sales.export', 'marketing.stats'], 'import' => null, 'dates' => true, 'loc' => true,
        'help' => 'Une ligne par article vendu, avec le client, l’origine et la campagne.',
        'cols' => ['date' => 'Date', 'number' => 'N° vente', 'loc' => 'Showroom', 'status' => 'Statut', 'client' => 'Client', 'phone' => 'Téléphone', 'city' => 'Ville',
            'source' => 'Origine', 'campaign' => 'Campagne', 'product' => 'Article', 'sku' => 'Référence', 'family' => 'Famille', 'qty' => 'Quantité',
            'list' => 'Prix catalogue', 'unit' => 'Prix unitaire', 'line' => 'Total ligne', 'sale_total' => 'Total vente', 'paid' => 'Payé', 'rest' => 'Reste', 'seller' => 'Vendeur'],
        'rows' => function (array $f) {
            $loc = export_scope($f);
            $hidePhone = user()['role'] === 'marketing';
            foreach (all('SELECT s.*, si.label, si.qty, si.list_price, si.unit_price, si.total line, p.sku, p.family, l.name loc, c.name client, c.phone, c.city, cp.name camp, u.name seller
                FROM sale_items si JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id JOIN locations l ON l.id = s.location_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id
                LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.id = s.client_id LEFT JOIN campaigns cp ON cp.id = s.campaign_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id
                WHERE date(s.created_at) BETWEEN ? AND ?' . ($loc ? ' AND s.location_id = ' . (int)$loc : '') . ' ORDER BY s.id, si.id', [$f['from'], $f['to']]) as $r) {
                $st = ['payee' => 'Payée', 'partielle' => 'Reste à payer', 'annulee' => 'Annulée'][$r['status']] ?? $r['status'];
                yield [$r['created_at'], $r['number'], $r['loc'], $st, $r['client'], $hidePhone ? '' : $r['phone'], $r['city'], SOURCES[$r['source']] ?? '', $r['camp'],
                    $r['label'], $r['sku'], $r['family'], $r['qty'], csv_money($r['list_price']), csv_money($r['unit_price']), csv_money($r['line']),
                    csv_money($r['total']), csv_money($r['paid']), csv_money($r['status'] === 'annulee' ? 0 : $r['total'] - $r['paid']), $r['seller']];
            }
        },
    ];

    $ds['paiements'] = [
        'label' => 'Paiements & encaissements', 'icon' => 'cash', 'export' => 'payments.export', 'import' => null, 'dates' => true, 'loc' => true,
        'help' => 'Tous les encaissements (et remboursements en négatif) par mode de paiement — pour le rapprochement bancaire.',
        'cols' => ['date' => 'Date', 'sale' => 'N° vente / facture', 'loc' => 'Showroom', 'method' => 'Mode', 'amount' => 'Montant', 'ref' => 'Référence', 'session' => 'Session de caisse', 'user' => 'Par'],
        'rows' => function (array $f) {
            $loc = export_scope($f);
            foreach (all('SELECT p.*, s.number, l.name loc, u.name un FROM payments p JOIN sales s ON s.id = p.sale_id JOIN locations l ON l.id = p.location_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
                WHERE date(p.created_at) BETWEEN ? AND ?' . ($loc ? ' AND p.location_id = ' . (int)$loc : '') . ' ORDER BY p.id', [$f['from'], $f['to']]) as $p) {
                yield [$p['created_at'], $p['number'], $p['loc'], PAY_METHODS[$p['method']] ?? $p['method'], csv_money($p['amount']), $p['reference'], $p['session_id'], $p['un']];
            }
            // Paiements de factures établies hors caisse
            foreach (all('SELECT dp.*, d.number, l.name loc, u.name un FROM document_payments dp JOIN documents d ON d.id = dp.document_id LEFT JOIN locations l ON l.id = dp.location_id
                LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = dp.user_id WHERE d.sale_id IS NULL AND dp.date BETWEEN ? AND ?' . ($loc ? ' AND dp.location_id = ' . (int)$loc : '') . ' ORDER BY dp.id', [$f['from'], $f['to']]) as $p) {
                yield [$p['date'], 'Facture ' . $p['number'], $p['loc'] ?: 'Siège', PAY_METHODS[$p['method']] ?? $p['method'], csv_money($p['amount']), $p['reference'], $p['session_id'], $p['un']];
            }
        },
    ];

    $ds['caisses'] = [
        'label' => 'Sessions de caisse (clôtures)', 'icon' => 'pos', 'export' => 'sessions.export', 'import' => null, 'dates' => true, 'loc' => true,
        'help' => 'Ouvertures, clôtures, espèces attendues et comptées, écarts, versements au coffre.',
        'cols' => ['id' => 'N°', 'loc' => 'Showroom', 'opened' => 'Ouverture', 'closed' => 'Clôture', 'float' => 'Fond de caisse', 'expected' => 'Espèces attendues',
            'counted' => 'Espèces comptées', 'diff' => 'Écart', 'safe' => 'Versé au coffre', 'envelope' => 'Enveloppe', 'note' => 'Justification'],
        'rows' => function (array $f) {
            $loc = export_scope($f);
            foreach (all('SELECT cs.*, l.name loc FROM cash_sessions cs JOIN locations l ON l.id = cs.location_id WHERE date(cs.opened_at) BETWEEN ? AND ?'
                . ($loc ? ' AND cs.location_id = ' . (int)$loc : '') . ' ORDER BY cs.id', [$f['from'], $f['to']]) as $s) {
                yield [$s['id'], $s['loc'], $s['opened_at'], $s['closed_at'], csv_money($s['opening_float']), csv_money($s['expected_cash']), csv_money($s['counted_cash']),
                    csv_money($s['difference']), csv_money($s['to_safe']), $s['envelope'], $s['note']];
            }
        },
    ];

    $ds['creances'] = [
        'label' => 'Reste à encaisser (créances)', 'icon' => 'wallet', 'export' => 'sales.export', 'import' => null,
        'help' => 'Ventes avec un reste à payer (facilités, acomptes).',
        'cols' => ['date' => 'Date', 'number' => 'N° vente', 'loc' => 'Showroom', 'client' => 'Client', 'phone' => 'Téléphone', 'total' => 'Total', 'paid' => 'Payé', 'rest' => 'Reste'],
        'rows' => function (array $f) {
            $loc = scope_loc();
            foreach (all("SELECT s.*, l.name loc, c.name client, c.phone FROM sales s JOIN locations l ON l.id = s.location_id LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.id = s.client_id
                WHERE s.status = 'partielle'" . ($loc ? ' AND s.location_id = ' . (int)$loc : '') . ' ORDER BY s.created_at') as $r) {
                yield [$r['created_at'], $r['number'], $r['loc'], $r['client'], $r['phone'], csv_money($r['total']), csv_money($r['paid']), csv_money($r['total'] - $r['paid'])];
            }
        },
    ];

    $ds['clients'] = [
        'label' => 'Clients', 'icon' => 'users', 'export' => 'clients.export', 'import' => 'clients.import',
        'help' => 'Correspondance par ID puis par téléphone (8 chiffres). Les doublons de téléphone sont fusionnés.',
        'cols' => ['id' => 'ID', 'name' => 'Nom', 'phone' => 'Téléphone', 'phone2' => 'Téléphone 2', 'email' => 'E-mail', 'gouvernorat' => 'Gouvernorat',
            'city' => 'Ville', 'address' => 'Adresse', 'source' => 'Origine', 'notes' => 'Notes', 'created_at' => 'Créé le', 'sales_total' => 'Total achats'],
        'rows' => function (array $f) {
            foreach (all("SELECT c.*, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) FROM sales s WHERE s.client_id = c.id AND s.status <> 'annulee') t FROM clients c ORDER BY c.name") as $c) {
                yield [$c['id'], $c['name'], $c['phone'], $c['phone2'], $c['email'], $c['gouvernorat'], $c['city'], $c['address'], SOURCES[$c['source']] ?? $c['source'],
                    $c['notes'], $c['created_at'], csv_money($c['t'])];
            }
        },
        'import_row' => function (array $r) {
            $name = trim($r['name'] ?? '');
            $phone = normalize_phone($r['phone'] ?? '');
            if ($name === '' && $phone === '') return 'skipped';
            $ex = ($id = parse_int($r['id'] ?? '')) ? one('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?', [$id]) : null;
            if (!$ex && $phone !== '') $ex = one('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE phone = ?', [$phone]);
            $data = ['updated_at' => now()];
            foreach (['name', 'email', 'gouvernorat', 'city', 'address', 'notes'] as $k) if (isset($r[$k]) && trim($r[$k]) !== '') $data[$k] = trim($r[$k]);
            if ($phone !== '') $data['phone'] = $phone;
            if (trim($r['phone2'] ?? '') !== '') $data['phone2'] = normalize_phone($r['phone2']);
            if (trim($r['source'] ?? '') !== '') $data['source'] = key_from_label(SOURCES, $r['source'], 'autre');
            if ($ex) { update('clients', $data, 'id = ?', [$ex['id']]); return 'updated'; }
            if ($name === '') $data['name'] = 'Client ' . $phone;
            insert('clients', $data + ['created_at' => now()]);
            return 'created';
        },
    ];

    $ds['transporteurs'] = [
        'label' => 'Transporteurs', 'icon' => 'truck', 'export' => 'deliveries.export', 'import' => 'carriers.import',
        'help' => 'Correspondance par ID puis par nom.',
        'cols' => ['id' => 'ID', 'name' => 'Nom', 'type' => 'Type', 'phone' => 'Téléphone', 'contact' => 'Contact', 'zones' => 'Zones', 'default_fee' => 'Tarif par défaut', 'cod' => 'Paiement à la livraison', 'active' => 'Actif', 'notes' => 'Notes'],
        'rows' => function () {
            foreach (all('SELECT * FROM carriers ORDER BY name') as $c) {
                yield [$c['id'], $c['name'], $c['type'], $c['phone'], $c['contact'], $c['zones'], csv_money($c['default_fee']), csv_bool($c['cod']), csv_bool($c['active']), $c['notes']];
            }
        },
        'import_row' => function (array $r) {
            $name = trim($r['name'] ?? '');
            if ($name === '') return 'skipped';
            $ex = ($id = parse_int($r['id'] ?? '')) ? one('SELECT * FROM carriers WHERE id = ?', [$id]) : null;
            if (!$ex) $ex = one('SELECT * FROM carriers WHERE name = ? COLLATE NOCASE', [$name]);
            $data = ['name' => $name, 'type' => slug_key($r['type'] ?? '') === 'interne' ? 'interne' : 'externe'];
            foreach (['phone', 'contact', 'zones', 'notes'] as $k) if (isset($r[$k])) $data[$k] = trim($r[$k]);
            if (isset($r['default_fee'])) $data['default_fee'] = max(0, parse_money($r['default_fee']) ?? 0);
            if (isset($r['cod']) && trim($r['cod']) !== '') $data['cod'] = csv_yes($r['cod']) ? 1 : 0;
            if (isset($r['active']) && trim($r['active']) !== '') $data['active'] = csv_yes($r['active']) ? 1 : 0;
            if ($ex) { update('carriers', $data, 'id = ?', [$ex['id']]); return 'updated'; }
            insert('carriers', $data + ['created_at' => now()]);
            return 'created';
        },
    ];

    $ds['livraisons'] = [
        'label' => 'Livraisons', 'icon' => 'truck', 'export' => 'deliveries.export', 'import' => 'deliveries.import', 'loc' => true,
        'help' => 'Mise à jour en masse par N° de livraison (statut, n° de suivi, frais…). Sans N°, une nouvelle livraison est créée. Statuts : ' . implode(', ', SHIP_STATUS) . '.',
        'cols' => ['number' => 'N° livraison', 'sale' => 'N° vente', 'loc' => 'Départ', 'recipient' => 'Destinataire', 'phone' => 'Téléphone', 'gouvernorat' => 'Gouvernorat',
            'city' => 'Ville', 'address' => 'Adresse', 'carrier' => 'Transporteur', 'tracking' => 'N° de suivi', 'status' => 'Statut', 'planned_date' => 'Date prévue',
            'delivered_at' => 'Livrée le', 'fee' => 'Coût transport', 'cod_amount' => 'À encaisser', 'cod_collected' => 'Encaissé', 'note' => 'Note',
            'goods' => 'Marchandise', 'holder' => 'Où est la marchandise', 'technician' => 'Technicien', 'technician_fee' => 'Prime technicien',
            'client_fee' => 'Transport payé par le client'],
        'rows' => function (array $f) {
            $loc = export_scope($f);
            foreach (all('SELECT sh.*, s.number sale, l.code loc, ca.name carrier,
                    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN si.qty > 1 THEN si.qty || \' × \' ELSE \'\' END || si.label, \' + \') FROM shipment_items si WHERE si.shipment_id = sh.id) goods

function ds_can(array $d, string $what): bool
{
    $perm = $d[$what] ?? null;
    if (!$perm) return false;
    foreach ((array)$perm as $p) if (can($p)) return true;
    return false;
}

/** Envoie l'export CSV d'un jeu de données. */
function ds_export(string $key, array $f, bool $templateOnly = false): void
{
    $d = datasets()[$key] ?? null;
    if (!$d || !ds_can($d, $templateOnly ? 'import' : 'export')) {
        http_response_code(403);
        exit('Export non autorisé.');
    }
    $cols = $d['cols'];
    if ($key === 'produits' && !is_admin()) unset($cols['cost']);
    $rows = $templateOnly ? [] : (function () use ($d, $f, $key) {
        foreach ($d['rows']($f) as $r) {
            if ($key === 'produits' && !is_admin()) unset($r[9]);
            yield array_values($r);
        }
    })();
    $name = $key . ($templateOnly ? '-modele' : '') . (!empty($d['dates']) && !$templateOnly ? '-' . $f['from'] . '_' . $f['to'] : '') . '-' . date('Ymd-Hi') . '.csv';
    if (!$templateOnly) audit('export CSV', $key, null, $d['label']);
    csv_send($name, array_values($cols), $rows);
}

/** Importe (ou simule) un fichier. Retourne un rapport. */
function ds_import(string $key, string $file, bool $commit, array $opts): array
{
    $d = datasets()[$key] ?? null;
    if (!$d || !ds_can($d, 'import')) throw new RuntimeException('Import non autorisé.');
    $csv = csv_read_file($file);
    $woo = $key === 'produits' && csv_is_woo($csv['headers']);
    $map = [];
    foreach ($d['cols'] as $k => $label) {
        $map[slug_key($label)] = $k;
        $map[slug_key($k)] = $k;
    }
    $unknown = [];
    $known = [];
    if (!$woo) {
        foreach ($csv['headers'] as $i => $h) {
            if ($h === '') continue;
            if (isset($map[$h])) $known[] = $map[$h];
            else $unknown[] = $csv['labels'][$i];
        }
        if (!$known) throw new RuntimeException('Aucune colonne reconnue. Téléchargez le modèle CSV pour voir les en-têtes attendus.');
    }
    $report = ['created' => 0, 'updated' => 0, 'skipped' => 0, 'errors' => [], 'total' => count($csv['rows']), 'unknown' => $unknown,
        'woo' => $woo, 'columns' => $woo ? ['Format WooCommerce (export du site)'] : array_values(array_unique(array_map(fn($k) => $d['cols'][$k], $known)))];
    $opts['woo'] = $woo;
    $pdo = db();
    $pdo->beginTransaction();
    try {
        foreach ($csv['rows'] as $row) {
            $line = $row['__line'];
            unset($row['__line']);
            $r = [];
            if ($woo) $r = $row;
            else foreach ($row as $h => $v) if (isset($map[$h])) $r[$map[$h]] = $v;
            $pdo->exec('SAVEPOINT r');
            try {
                $res = $d['import_row']($r, $opts);
                $report[$res]++;
                $pdo->exec('RELEASE r');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $pdo->exec('ROLLBACK TO r');
                $pdo->exec('RELEASE r');
                if (count($report['errors']) < 200) $report['errors'][] = "Ligne $line : " . $e->getMessage();
            }
        }
        if ($commit) {
            $pdo->commit();
            audit('import CSV', $key, null, $d['label'] . " · {$report['created']} créé(s), {$report['updated']} mis à jour, " . count($report['errors']) . ' erreur(s)');
        } else {
            $pdo->rollBack();
        }
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        if ($pdo->inTransaction()) $pdo->rollBack();
        throw $e;
    }
    return $report;
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

function db_path(): string
{
    return getenv('FTN_DB') ?: DATA_DIR . '/erp.sqlite';
}

function db(): PDO
{
    static $pdo = null;
    if ($pdo) return $pdo;
    $path = db_path();
    $fresh = !is_file($path) || filesize($path) === 0;
    $pdo = new PDO('sqlite:' . $path, null, null, [
        PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
        PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
    ]);
    $pdo->exec('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON');
    $pdo->exec('PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000');
    // WAL seulement en local : sur un hébergement mutualisé (disque réseau) le mode classique est plus sûr.
    $pdo->exec('PRAGMA journal_mode = ' . (PHP_SAPI === 'cli-server' || getenv('FTN_WAL') ? 'WAL' : 'DELETE'));
    if ($fresh || !table_exists($pdo, 'settings')) {
        db_install($pdo);
    }
    db_migrate($pdo);
    return $pdo;
}

const DB_VERSION = 5;

/** Met à jour le schéma d'une base existante (fichiers app/migrations/NNN_*.sql). */
function db_migrate(PDO $pdo): void
{
    $version = fn() => (int)($pdo->query("SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'schema_version'")->fetchColumn() ?: 1);
    if ($version() >= DB_VERSION) return;
    $pdo->exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');
    try {
        $v = $version();
        foreach (glob(__DIR__ . '/migrations/*.sql') ?: [] as $file) {
            $n = (int)basename($file);
            if ($n <= $v || $n > DB_VERSION) continue;
            $pdo->exec(file_get_contents($file));
        }
        $defaults = [
            'company_legal_name' => '', 'company_address' => '',
            'invoice_prefix' => '', 'quote_prefix' => 'DV-',
            'invoice_terms' => 'Paiement comptant à la livraison', 'invoice_transport' => 'Gratuit', 'invoice_warranty' => 'Selon le produit',
            'quote_validity_days' => '15', 'invoice_due_days' => '0', 'doc_color' => '#145c54', 'doc_stamp' => '', 'auto_backup' => '1',
            'x_api_key' => '',
            'bank_name' => '', 'bank_rib' => '', 'bank_iban' => '', 'bank_bic' => '',
            'warranty_notice' => "Toute utilisation hors du cadre domestique (usage professionnel, salle de sport, collectivité, kiné…) ou non conforme aux conditions normales d’utilisation entraîne l’annulation immédiate de la garantie.\n"
                . 'يلغى الضمان تلقائيا في حالة ثبوت استخدام الجهاز خارج النطاق المنزلي الخاص أو في ظروف لا تتوافق مع معايير الاستخدام المنصوص عليها.',
        ];
        $st = $pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO settings(key, value) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO NOTHING');
        foreach ($defaults as $k => $d) $st->execute([$k, $d]);
        $pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO settings(key, value) VALUES ('schema_version', ?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value")->execute([(string)DB_VERSION]);
        $pdo->exec('COMMIT');
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        $pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');
        throw $e;
    }
}

function backup_dir(): string
{
    return getenv('FTN_BACKUP_DIR') ?: DATA_DIR . '/backups';
}

/**
 * Copie de la base une fois par jour (au premier passage d'un utilisateur connecté), 14 jours conservés.
 * Pas dans la démo navigateur (fichiers sous /www), ni pour une base de test sans FTN_BACKUP_DIR.
 */
function db_auto_backup(): void
{
    if (str_starts_with(DATA_DIR, '/www') || (getenv('FTN_DB') && !getenv('FTN_BACKUP_DIR'))) return;
    if (setting('auto_backup', '1') !== '1' || setting('last_backup') === today()) return;
    $dir = backup_dir();
    if (!is_dir($dir) && !@mkdir($dir, 0775, true)) return;
    $file = $dir . '/erp-' . today() . '.sqlite';
    try {
        set_setting('last_backup', today());
        if (!is_file($file)) db()->exec('VACUUM INTO ' . db()->quote($file));
        $all = glob($dir . '/erp-*.sqlite') ?: [];
        sort($all);
        foreach (array_slice($all, 0, max(0, count($all) - 14)) as $old) @unlink($old);
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        error_log('[ERP] sauvegarde automatique : ' . $e->getMessage());
    }
}

function table_exists(PDO $pdo, string $t): bool
{
    $st = $pdo->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name=?");
    $st->execute([$t]);
    return (bool)$st->fetchColumn();
}

function q(string $sql, array $p = []): PDOStatement
{
    $st = db()->prepare($sql);
    $st->execute($p);
    return $st;
}

function one(string $sql, array $p = []): ?array
{
    $r = q($sql, $p)->fetch();
    return $r ?: null;
}

function all(string $sql, array $p = []): array
{
    return q($sql, $p)->fetchAll();
}

function val(string $sql, array $p = [])
{
    $v = q($sql, $p)->fetchColumn();
    return $v === false ? null : $v;
}

function insert(string $table, array $data): int
{
    $cols = array_keys($data);
    $sql = 'INSERT INTO ' . $table . ' (' . implode(',', $cols) . ') VALUES (' . implode(',', array_fill(0, count($cols), '?')) . ')';
    q($sql, array_values($data));
    return (int)db()->lastInsertId();
}

function update(string $table, array $data, string $where, array $wp = []): int
{
    $set = implode(',', array_map(fn($c) => "$c = ?", array_keys($data)));
    return q("UPDATE $table SET $set WHERE $where", array_merge(array_values($data), $wp))->rowCount();
}

/** Exécute $fn dans une transaction (ou un savepoint si une transaction est déjà ouverte). */
function tx(callable $fn)
{
    $pdo = db();
    if ($pdo->inTransaction()) {
        $sp = 'sp' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4));
        $pdo->exec("SAVEPOINT $sp");
        try {
            $r = $fn();
            $pdo->exec("RELEASE $sp");
            return $r;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $pdo->exec("ROLLBACK TO $sp");
            $pdo->exec("RELEASE $sp");
            throw $e;
        }
    }
    $pdo->beginTransaction();
    try {
        $r = $fn();
        $pdo->commit();
        return $r;
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        $pdo->rollBack();
        throw $e;
    }
}

/** Numéro suivant d'une séquence (ex. ventes TUN 2026). */
function next_seq(string $key): int
{
    q('INSERT INTO counters(key, value) VALUES (?, 0) ON CONFLICT(key) DO NOTHING', [$key]);
    q('UPDATE counters SET value = value + 1 WHERE key = ?', [$key]);
    return (int)val('SELECT value FROM counters WHERE key = ?', [$key]);
}

/* ---------- Paramètres ---------- */

function setting(string $key, $default = null)
{
    static $cache = null;
    if ($cache === null || $key === '__reset') {
        $cache = [];
        foreach (all('SELECT key, value FROM settings') as $r) $cache[$r['key']] = $r['value'];
        if ($key === '__reset') return null;
    }
    return $cache[$key] ?? $default;
}

function set_setting(string $key, $value): void
{
    q('INSERT INTO settings(key, value) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value', [$key, (string)$value]);
    setting('__reset');
}

/* ---------- Emplacements ---------- */

function locations(bool $activeOnly = true, ?string $type = null): array
{
    static $all = null;
    if ($all === null) $all = all('SELECT * FROM locations ORDER BY position, id');
    return array_values(array_filter($all, fn($l) => (!$activeOnly || $l['active']) && (!$type || $l['type'] === $type)));
}

function location(?int $id): ?array
{
    foreach (locations(false) as $l) if ((int)$l['id'] === (int)$id) return $l;
    return null;
}

function location_options(bool $activeOnly = true, ?string $type = null): array
{
    $o = [];
    foreach (locations($activeOnly, $type) as $l) $o[$l['id']] = $l['name'];
    return $o;
}

/* ---------- Journal ---------- */

function audit(string $action, string $entity = '', $entityId = null, string $details = ''): void
{
    $u = $_SESSION['uid'] ?? null;
    insert('audit_log', [
        'created_at' => now(), 'user_id' => $u, 'action' => $action, 'entity' => $entity,

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/* ---------- Devis & factures ---------- */

const DOC_TYPES = ['devis' => 'Devis', 'facture' => 'Facture'];

const DOC_STATUS = [
    'devis' => ['brouillon' => 'Brouillon', 'envoye' => 'Envoyé', 'accepte' => 'Accepté', 'refuse' => 'Refusé', 'facture' => 'Facturé'],
    'facture' => ['emise' => 'À encaisser', 'partielle' => 'Paiement partiel', 'payee' => 'Payée', 'annulee' => 'Annulée'],
];

const VAT_RATES = ['19' => '19 %', '13' => '13 %', '7' => '7 %', '0' => '0 %'];

function doc_route(string $type): string
{
    return $type === 'devis' ? 'quotes' : 'invoices';
}

/** Devis dont la validité est dépassée sans réponse. */
function doc_expired(array $d): bool
{
    return $d['type'] === 'devis' && in_array($d['status'], ['brouillon', 'envoye'], true) && $d['due_date'] && $d['due_date'] < today();
}

/** Facture non soldée après l'échéance. */
function doc_overdue(array $d): bool
{
    return $d['type'] === 'facture' && in_array($d['status'], ['emise', 'partielle'], true) && $d['due_date'] && $d['due_date'] < today();
}

/** [libellé, ton du badge] en tenant compte de l'expiration / du retard. */
function doc_badge(array $d): string
{
    if (doc_expired($d)) return badge('Expiré', 'warn');
    if (doc_overdue($d)) return badge('En retard', 'err');
    $tone = ['brouillon' => '', 'envoye' => 'info', 'accepte' => 'ok', 'refuse' => 'err', 'facture' => 'ok',
        'emise' => 'warn', 'partielle' => 'warn', 'payee' => 'ok', 'annulee' => 'err'][$d['status']] ?? '';
    return badge(DOC_STATUS[$d['type']][$d['status']] ?? $d['status'], $tone);
}

function doc_number(string $type): string
{
    $prefix = (string)setting($type === 'devis' ? 'quote_prefix' : 'invoice_prefix', $type === 'devis' ? 'DV-' : '');
    $n = next_seq('doc:' . $type . ':' . date('Y'));
    return $prefix . str_pad((string)$n, 6, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT) . '/' . date('y');
}

/** Prochain numéro qui sera attribué cette année (paramètres). */
function doc_next_number(string $type): int
{
    return (int)(val('SELECT value FROM counters WHERE key = ?', ['doc:' . $type . ':' . date('Y')]) ?? 0) + 1;
}

function doc_set_next_number(string $type, int $next): void
{
    $key = 'doc:' . $type . ':' . date('Y');
    $max = 0;
    $prefix = (string)setting($type === 'devis' ? 'quote_prefix' : 'invoice_prefix', '');
    foreach (all("SELECT number FROM documents WHERE type = ? AND number LIKE ?", [$type, '%/' . date('y')]) as $r) {
        $num = substr($r['number'], strlen($prefix));
        if (preg_match('/^(\d+)\//', $num, $m)) $max = max($max, (int)$m[1]);
    }
    if ($next <= $max) throw new RuntimeException("Le numéro $next est déjà utilisé : le prochain numéro doit être supérieur à $max.");
    q('INSERT INTO counters(key, value) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value', [$key, $next - 1]);
}

function doc_items(int $docId): array
{
    return all('SELECT di.*, p.sku, p.image, p.image_url, p.family FROM document_items di LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = di.product_id
        WHERE di.document_id = ? ORDER BY di.position, di.id', [$docId]);
}

function doc_get(int $id, ?string $type = null): ?array
{
    $d = one('SELECT d.*, u.name AS author FROM documents d LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = d.created_by WHERE d.id = ?', [$id]);
    if (!$d || ($type && $d['type'] !== $type) || !can_loc($d['location_id'] !== null ? (int)$d['location_id'] : null)) return null;
    return $d;
}

/**
 * Normalise les lignes saisies et calcule les totaux.
 * Lignes : product_id, label, description, qty, unit_price (TTC), discount_pct, vat_rate.
 */
function doc_compute(array $rawItems, $discount, bool $timbre): array
{
    $items = [];
    $subtotal = 0;
    $pos = 0;
    foreach ($rawItems as $it) {
        $label = trim((string)($it['label'] ?? ''));
        $pid = !empty($it['product_id']) ? (int)$it['product_id'] : null;
        if ($label === '' && !$pid) continue;
        $qty = parse_int($it['qty'] ?? 1, 0);
        if ($qty < 1 || $qty > 9999) throw new RuntimeException('Quantité invalide' . ($label ? " pour « $label »" : '') . '.');
        $unit = parse_money($it['unit_price'] ?? null);
        if ($unit === null || $unit < 0) throw new RuntimeException('Prix invalide' . ($label ? " pour « $label »" : '') . '.');
        $disc = (float)str_replace(',', '.', (string)($it['discount_pct'] ?? 0));
        if ($disc < 0 || $disc > 100) throw new RuntimeException('Remise de ligne : entre 0 et 100 %.');
        $vat = (float)str_replace(',', '.', (string)($it['vat_rate'] ?? setting('vat_rate', 19)));
        if (!in_array($vat, [0.0, 7.0, 13.0, 19.0], true)) $vat = (float)setting('vat_rate', 19);
        $warranty = null;
        if ($pid) {
            $p = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [$pid]);
            if (!$p) throw new RuntimeException('Produit introuvable.');
            if ($label === '') $label = $p['name'];
            $warranty = $p['warranty_months'] !== null ? (int)$p['warranty_months'] : null;
        }
        $total = (int)round($unit * $qty * (1 - $disc / 100));
        $items[] = ['product_id' => $pid, 'label' => mb_substr($label, 0, 200), 'description' => mb_substr(trim((string)($it['description'] ?? '')), 0, 500),
            'qty' => $qty, 'unit_price' => $unit, 'discount_pct' => $disc, 'vat_rate' => $vat, 'total' => $total,
            'warranty_months' => $warranty, 'position' => $pos++];
        $subtotal += $total;
    }
    if (!$items) throw new RuntimeException('Ajoutez au moins une ligne.');
    $discount = parse_money($discount) ?? 0;
    if ($discount < 0 || $discount > $subtotal) throw new RuntimeException('Remise globale invalide.');
    $total = $subtotal - $discount;
    $vat = sale_vat(['subtotal' => $subtotal, 'total' => $total], $items);
    $ht = array_sum(array_column($vat, 'ht'));
    $tim = $timbre ? (int)setting('timbre', 1000) : 0;
    return ['items' => $items, 'subtotal' => $subtotal, 'discount' => $discount, 'total' => $total, 'total_ht' => $ht,
        'total_vat' => $total - $ht, 'timbre' => $tim, 'net' => $total + $tim, 'vat' => $vat];
}

/** Sort (ou remet, $sign = +1) les articles d'une facture du stock de son showroom. */
function doc_stock(array $doc, array $items, int $sign): void
{
    if (!$doc['location_id']) return;
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        if (!empty($it['product_id'])) {
            stock_change((int)$it['product_id'], (int)$doc['location_id'], $sign * (int)$it['qty'], $sign < 0 ? 'vente' : 'annulation', $doc['number']);
        }
    }
}

function doc_paid_status(int $net, int $paid): string
{
    if ($paid <= 0) return 'emise';
    return $paid >= $net ? 'payee' : 'partielle';
}

/**
 * Crée ou modifie un devis / une facture. $in : type, id, location_id, client{}, date, due_date, items[], discount,
 * timbre, terms, transport, warranty, notes, internal_note, stock. Retourne l'id.
 */
function doc_save(array $in): int
{
    $u = user();
    $id = (int)($in['id'] ?? 0);
    $old = $id ? doc_get($id) : null;
    if ($id && !$old) throw new RuntimeException('Document introuvable.');
    $type = $old['type'] ?? (string)($in['type'] ?? '');
    if (!isset(DOC_TYPES[$type])) throw new RuntimeException('Type de document inconnu.');
    if ($old && !doc_editable($old)) throw new RuntimeException('Ce document ne peut plus être modifié.');

    $locId = scope_loc() ?? ((int)($in['location_id'] ?? 0) ?: null);
    if ($locId && !location($locId)) throw new RuntimeException('Showroom inconnu.');
    $date = parse_date($in['date'] ?? null) ?? today();
    $due = parse_date($in['due_date'] ?? null);
    if ($due && $due < $date) throw new RuntimeException($type === 'devis' ? 'La date de validité précède la date du devis.' : 'L’échéance précède la date de la facture.');

    $c = (array)($in['client'] ?? []);
    $cname = trim((string)($c['name'] ?? ''));
    if ($cname === '') throw new RuntimeException('Le nom du client est obligatoire.');
    $calc = doc_compute((array)($in['items'] ?? []), $in['discount'] ?? 0, !empty($in['timbre']));
    if ($old && $old['type'] === 'facture' && (int)$old['paid'] > $calc['net']) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Le nouveau total est inférieur aux paiements déjà reçus (' . money($old['paid']) . ').');
    }

    return tx(function () use ($u, $old, $type, $locId, $date, $due, $c, $cname, $calc, $in) {
        $phone = normalize_phone((string)($c['phone'] ?? ''));
        $clientId = !empty($c['id']) ? (int)$c['id'] : null;
        if (!$clientId && $phone === '') $clientId = (int)val('SELECT id FROM clients WHERE name = ? COLLATE NOCASE ORDER BY id LIMIT 1', [$cname]) ?: null;
        if (!$clientId) $clientId = client_upsert(['name' => $cname, 'phone' => $phone, 'address' => (string)($c['address'] ?? '')]);
        if ($clientId) {
            $ex = one('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?', [$clientId]);
            if (!$ex) throw new RuntimeException('Client introuvable.');
            $upd = [];
            foreach (['mf' => 'mf', 'email' => 'email', 'address' => 'address'] as $k => $col) {
                $v = trim((string)($c[$k] ?? ''));
                if ($v !== '' && trim((string)$ex[$col]) === '') $upd[$col] = $v;
            }
            if ($upd) update('clients', $upd + ['updated_at' => now()], 'id = ?', [$clientId]);
        }
        $data = [
            'location_id' => $locId, 'client_id' => $clientId,
            'client_name' => mb_substr($cname, 0, 160), 'client_phone' => $phone, 'client_email' => mb_substr(trim((string)($c['email'] ?? '')), 0, 160),
            'client_address' => mb_substr(trim((string)($c['address'] ?? '')), 0, 300), 'client_mf' => mb_substr(trim((string)($c['mf'] ?? '')), 0, 60),
            'date' => $date, 'due_date' => $due,
            'subtotal' => $calc['subtotal'], 'discount' => $calc['discount'], 'total_ht' => $calc['total_ht'], 'total_vat' => $calc['total_vat'],
            'total' => $calc['total'], 'timbre' => $calc['timbre'], 'net' => $calc['net'],
            'terms' => mb_substr(trim((string)($in['terms'] ?? '')), 0, 300), 'transport' => mb_substr(trim((string)($in['transport'] ?? '')), 0, 120),
            'warranty' => mb_substr(trim((string)($in['warranty'] ?? '')), 0, 160), 'notes' => mb_substr(trim((string)($in['notes'] ?? '')), 0, 1000),
            'internal_note' => mb_substr(trim((string)($in['internal_note'] ?? '')), 0, 1000), 'updated_at' => now(),
        ];
        if ($old) {
            // Les articles déjà sortis du stock sont remis avant d'appliquer les nouvelles lignes.
            if ($old['stock_applied']) doc_stock($old, doc_items((int)$old['id']), +1);
            $id = (int)$old['id'];
            update('documents', $data, 'id = ?', [$id]);
            q('DELETE FROM document_items WHERE document_id = ?', [$id]);
            $saleId = $old['sale_id'];
        } else {
            $saleId = !empty($in['sale_id']) ? (int)$in['sale_id'] : null;
            $id = insert('documents', $data + ['type' => $type, 'number' => doc_number($type), 'status' => $type === 'devis' ? 'brouillon' : 'emise',
                'source_id' => !empty($in['source_id']) ? (int)$in['source_id'] : null, 'sale_id' => $saleId,
                'paid' => 0, 'created_by' => $u['id'] ?? null, 'created_at' => now()]);
        }
        foreach ($calc['items'] as $it) insert('document_items', ['document_id' => $id] + $it);
        $doc = one('SELECT * FROM documents WHERE id = ?', [$id]);
        if ($type === 'facture') {
            $applyStock = !$saleId && $locId && !empty($in['stock']);
            if ($applyStock) doc_stock($doc, $calc['items'], -1);
            update('documents', ['stock_applied' => $applyStock ? 1 : 0], 'id = ?', [$id]);
            doc_refresh_paid($id);
        }
        audit($old ? DOC_TYPES[$type] . ' modifié' . ($type === 'facture' ? 'e' : '') : DOC_TYPES[$type] . ' créé' . ($type === 'facture' ? 'e' : ''),
            'document', $id, $doc['number'] . ' · ' . $cname . ' · ' . money($calc['net']));
        return $id;
    });
}

/** Un devis reste modifiable tant qu'il n'est pas facturé ; une facture tant qu'elle n'est pas annulée (et sans paiement, sauf direction). */
function doc_editable(array $d): bool
{
    if (!can('invoices.edit') || !can_loc($d['location_id'] !== null ? (int)$d['location_id'] : null)) return false;
    if ($d['type'] === 'devis') return $d['status'] !== 'facture';
    if ($d['status'] === 'annulee') return false;
    return is_admin() || (int)$d['paid'] === 0;
}

function doc_set_status(array $d, string $status): void
{
    if ($d['type'] !== 'devis' || !in_array($status, ['brouillon', 'envoye', 'accepte', 'refuse'], true)) throw new RuntimeException('Statut invalide.');
    if ($d['status'] === 'facture') throw new RuntimeException('Ce devis est déjà facturé.');
    $data = ['status' => $status, 'updated_at' => now()];
    if ($status === 'envoye' && !$d['sent_at']) $data['sent_at'] = now();
    if (in_array($status, ['accepte', 'refuse'], true)) $data['closed_at'] = now();
    update('documents', $data, 'id = ?', [$d['id']]);
    audit('devis ' . mb_strtolower(DOC_STATUS['devis'][$status]), 'document', $d['id'], $d['number']);
}

/** Copie un document (devis → facture, ou duplication). Retourne l'id du nouveau document. */
function doc_copy(array $src, string $type, bool $stock = false): int
{
    $items = array_map(fn($it) => ['product_id' => $it['product_id'], 'label' => $it['label'], 'description' => $it['description'],
        'qty' => $it['qty'], 'unit_price' => m_in($it['unit_price']), 'discount_pct' => $it['discount_pct'], 'vat_rate' => $it['vat_rate']], doc_items((int)$src['id']));
    $toInvoice = $src['type'] === 'devis' && $type === 'facture';
    $days = (int)setting($type === 'devis' ? 'quote_validity_days' : 'invoice_due_days', 0);
    return tx(function () use ($src, $type, $items, $toInvoice, $days, $stock) {
        $id = doc_save([
            'type' => $type, 'location_id' => $src['location_id'],
            'client' => ['id' => $src['client_id'], 'name' => $src['client_name'], 'phone' => $src['client_phone'], 'email' => $src['client_email'],
                'address' => $src['client_address'], 'mf' => $src['client_mf']],
            'date' => today(), 'due_date' => $days > 0 ? date('Y-m-d', strtotime("+$days days")) : null,
            'items' => $items, 'discount' => m_in($src['discount']), 'timbre' => (int)$src['timbre'] > 0,
            'terms' => $src['terms'], 'transport' => $src['transport'], 'warranty' => $src['warranty'], 'notes' => $src['notes'],
            'source_id' => $toInvoice ? $src['id'] : null, 'stock' => $stock,
        ]);
        if ($toInvoice) {
            update('documents', ['status' => 'facture', 'closed_at' => $src['closed_at'] ?: now(), 'updated_at' => now()], 'id = ?', [$src['id']]);
            audit('devis facturé', 'document', $src['id'], $src['number']);
        }
        return $id;
    });
}

/** Facture établie à partir d'une vente de caisse (articles et paiements repris, stock déjà sorti). */
function doc_from_sale(int $saleId): int
{
    $s = one('SELECT s.*, c.name cname, c.phone cphone, c.email cemail, c.address caddr, c.city ccity, c.gouvernorat cgov, c.mf cmf
        FROM sales s LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.id = s.client_id WHERE s.id = ?', [$saleId]);
    if (!$s || !can_loc((int)$s['location_id'])) throw new RuntimeException('Vente introuvable.');
    if ($s['status'] === 'annulee') throw new RuntimeException('Cette vente est annulée.');
    if ($ex = val("SELECT id FROM documents WHERE sale_id = ? AND type = 'facture' AND status <> 'annulee'", [$saleId])) return (int)$ex;
    if (!$s['client_id']) throw new RuntimeException('Associez d’abord un client à la vente : une facture doit être nominative.');
    $items = array_map(fn($it) => ['product_id' => $it['product_id'], 'label' => $it['label'], 'qty' => $it['qty'],
        'unit_price' => m_in($it['unit_price']), 'discount_pct' => 0, 'vat_rate' => $it['vat_rate']], sale_items($saleId));
    return tx(function () use ($s, $items) {
        $id = doc_save([
            'type' => 'facture', 'location_id' => $s['location_id'],
            'client' => ['id' => $s['client_id'], 'name' => $s['cname'], 'phone' => $s['cphone'], 'email' => $s['cemail'],
                'address' => trim(implode(', ', array_filter([$s['caddr'], $s['ccity'], $s['cgov']])), ', '), 'mf' => $s['cmf']],
            'date' => substr($s['created_at'], 0, 10), 'items' => $items, 'discount' => m_in($s['discount']), 'timbre' => false,
            'terms' => setting('invoice_terms', ''), 'transport' => setting('invoice_transport', ''), 'warranty' => setting('invoice_warranty', ''),
            'notes' => 'Vente ' . $s['number'], 'sale_id' => $s['id'], 'stock' => false,
        ]);
        foreach (all('SELECT * FROM payments WHERE sale_id = ? ORDER BY id', [$s['id']]) as $p) {
            insert('document_payments', ['document_id' => $id, 'date' => substr($p['created_at'], 0, 10), 'method' => $p['method'],
                'amount' => (int)$p['amount'], 'reference' => $p['reference'] ?: $s['number'], 'user_id' => $p['user_id'], 'created_at' => now(),
                'location_id' => $s['location_id']]);
        }
        doc_refresh_paid($id);
        return $id;
    });
}

function doc_refresh_paid(int $id): void
{
    $d = one('SELECT * FROM documents WHERE id = ?', [$id]);
    $paid = (int)val('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM document_payments WHERE document_id = ?', [$id]);
    $data = ['paid' => $paid, 'updated_at' => now()];
    if ($d['type'] === 'facture' && $d['status'] !== 'annulee') $data['status'] = doc_paid_status((int)$d['net'], $paid);
    update('documents', $data, 'id = ?', [$id]);
}

function doc_add_payment(array $d, string $method, int $amount, string $reference, ?string $date): void
{
    if ($d['type'] !== 'facture' || $d['status'] === 'annulee') throw new RuntimeException('Paiement impossible sur ce document.');
    if (!isset(PAY_METHODS[$method])) throw new RuntimeException('Mode de paiement invalide.');
    $rest = (int)$d['net'] - (int)$d['paid'];
    if ($amount <= 0 || $amount > $rest) throw new RuntimeException('Montant invalide (reste à payer : ' . money($rest) . ').');
    // Espèces reçues au showroom : comptées dans la caisse ouverte (clôture et billetage).
    $session = $method === 'especes' && $d['location_id'] ? open_session((int)$d['location_id']) : null;
    tx(function () use ($d, $method, $amount, $reference, $date, $session) {
        insert('document_payments', ['document_id' => $d['id'], 'date' => $date ?: today(), 'method' => $method, 'amount' => $amount,
            'reference' => mb_substr($reference, 0, 80), 'user_id' => user()['id'] ?? null, 'created_at' => now(),
            'location_id' => $d['location_id'], 'session_id' => $session['id'] ?? null]);
        doc_refresh_paid((int)$d['id']);
        audit('paiement de facture', 'document', $d['id'], $d['number'] . ' · ' . PAY_METHODS[$method] . ' ' . money($amount));
    });
}

function doc_delete_payment(array $d, int $paymentId): void
{
    if (!is_admin()) throw new RuntimeException('Suppression réservée à l’administrateur.');
    $p = one('SELECT * FROM document_payments WHERE id = ? AND document_id = ?', [$paymentId, $d['id']]);
    if (!$p) throw new RuntimeException('Paiement introuvable.');
    if ($p['session_id'] && val("SELECT status FROM cash_sessions WHERE id = ?", [$p['session_id']]) === 'fermee') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Ce paiement en espèces fait partie d’une caisse déjà clôturée : il ne peut plus être supprimé.');
    }
    tx(function () use ($d, $p) {
        q('DELETE FROM document_payments WHERE id = ?', [$p['id']]);
        doc_refresh_paid((int)$d['id']);
        audit('paiement de facture supprimé', 'document', $d['id'], $d['number'] . ' · ' . money($p['amount']));
    });
}

/** Annulation d'une facture (direction) : le numéro reste attribué, le stock sorti est remis. */
function doc_cancel(array $d, string $reason): void
{
    if (!is_admin()) throw new RuntimeException('Seule la direction peut annuler une facture.');
    if ($d['type'] !== 'facture' || $d['status'] === 'annulee') throw new RuntimeException('Annulation impossible.');
    if (trim($reason) === '') throw new RuntimeException('Indiquez le motif de l’annulation.');
    tx(function () use ($d, $reason) {
        if ($d['stock_applied']) doc_stock($d, doc_items((int)$d['id']), +1);
        update('documents', ['status' => 'annulee', 'stock_applied' => 0, 'cancelled_at' => now(), 'cancelled_by' => user()['id'] ?? null,
            'cancel_reason' => mb_substr($reason, 0, 300), 'updated_at' => now()], 'id = ?', [$d['id']]);
        if ($d['source_id']) q("UPDATE documents SET status = 'accepte', updated_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND status = 'facture'", [now(), $d['source_id']]);
        audit('facture annulée', 'document', $d['id'], $d['number'] . ' · ' . $reason);
    });
}

function doc_delete(array $d): void
{
    if ($d['type'] !== 'devis') throw new RuntimeException('Une facture ne se supprime pas : annulez-la.');
    if ($d['status'] === 'facture') throw new RuntimeException('Ce devis est facturé : il ne peut pas être supprimé.');
    if (!is_admin() && (int)$d['created_by'] !== (int)user()['id']) throw new RuntimeException('Seul l’auteur du devis ou la direction peut le supprimer.');
    q('DELETE FROM documents WHERE id = ?', [$d['id']]);
    audit('devis supprimé', 'document', $d['id'], $d['number']);
}

/* ---------- Montant en lettres ---------- */

function fr_words(int $n): string
{
    if ($n === 0) return 'zéro';
    $units = ['', 'un', 'deux', 'trois', 'quatre', 'cinq', 'six', 'sept', 'huit', 'neuf', 'dix', 'onze', 'douze', 'treize', 'quatorze', 'quinze', 'seize'];
    $tens = [2 => 'vingt', 3 => 'trente', 4 => 'quarante', 5 => 'cinquante', 6 => 'soixante', 8 => 'quatre-vingt'];
    $below100 = function (int $n) use ($units, $tens): string {
        if ($n <= 16) return $units[$n];
        if ($n < 20) return 'dix-' . $units[$n - 10];
        $t = intdiv($n, 10);
        $u = $n % 10;
        if ($t === 7 || $t === 9) {
            $base = $t === 7 ? 'soixante' : 'quatre-vingt';
            $rest = $n - ($t === 7 ? 60 : 80);
            return $base . ($rest === 11 && $t === 7 ? ' et onze' : '-' . ($rest <= 16 ? $units[$rest] : 'dix-' . $units[$rest - 10]));
        }
        if ($u === 0) return $tens[$t] . ($t === 8 ? 's' : '');
        if ($u === 1 && $t !== 8) return $tens[$t] . ' et un';
        return $tens[$t] . '-' . $units[$u];
    };
    $below1000 = function (int $n) use ($below100): string {
        $h = intdiv($n, 100);
        $r = $n % 100;
        $s = '';
        if ($h > 0) $s = ($h > 1 ? $below100($h) . ' ' : '') . 'cent' . ($h > 1 && $r === 0 ? 's' : '');
        if ($r > 0) $s .= ($s ? ' ' : '') . $below100($r);
        return $s;
    };
    $parts = [];
    foreach ([[1000000000, 'milliard'], [1000000, 'million']] as [$div, $word]) {
        if ($n >= $div) {
            $k = intdiv($n, $div);
            $parts[] = $below1000($k) . ' ' . $word . ($k > 1 ? 's' : '');
            $n %= $div;
        }
    }
    if ($n >= 1000) {
        $k = intdiv($n, 1000);
        $w = $k === 1 ? 'mille' : preg_replace('/(vingt|cent)s$/', '$1', $below1000($k)) . ' mille';
        $parts[] = $w;
        $n %= 1000;
    }
    if ($n > 0) $parts[] = $below1000($n);
    return implode(' ', $parts);
}

/** 1 600 000 millimes -> « Mille six cents dinars ». */
function amount_words($millimes): string
{
    $m = (int)$millimes;
    $d = intdiv($m, 1000);
    $r = $m % 1000;
    $s = fr_words($d) . ' dinar' . ($d > 1 ? 's' : '');
    if ($r > 0) $s .= ' et ' . fr_words($r) . ' millime' . ($r > 1 ? 's' : '');
    return mb_strtoupper(mb_substr($s, 0, 1)) . mb_substr($s, 1);
}
