<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/*
 * Import des classeurs Excel tenus à la main par FitnessTN :
 *  - « VENTE GRAND TUNIS » (une feuille par mois) : ventes du showroom de Tunis + livraisons (transporteur, technicien, frais) ;
 *  - « PAIEMENT » : livraisons confiées aux transporteurs et argent récupéré (payé, retour, non payé) ;
 *  - « RÉPARATION ET SERVICE APRÈS VENTE » : fiches de réparation / SAV.
 * Chaque ligne reçoit une référence (import_ref) : réimporter le même fichier, complété, ne crée pas de doublon
 * et met à jour ce qui a changé (statut d'une réparation, paiement reçu d'un transporteur…).
 */

require_once __DIR__ . '/xlsx.php';

const XL_KINDS = [
    'ventes' => 'Ventes « VENTE GRAND TUNIS »',
    'paiements' => 'Paiements des transporteurs « PAIEMENT »',
    'reparations' => 'Réparations & service après-vente',
];

/** Transporteurs reconnus dans les textes (motif sur le texte en majuscules => nom, type, note). */
const XL_CARRIERS = [
    'JET ?PACK' => ['JetPack', 'externe', 'Société de livraison (paiement à la livraison).'],
    'BEST ?DEL' => ['Best Delivery', 'externe', 'Société de livraison (petits colis).'],
    'HAMMAMI' => ['Hammami Transport', 'externe', 'Société de transport (paiement à la livraison).'],
    '\bTPS\b' => ['TPS', 'externe', 'Société de transport (paiement à la livraison).'],
    'EXPRESS' => ['Express', 'externe', 'Société de livraison (paiement à la livraison).'],
    'KOUKI' => ['Omar Kouki (camion)', 'externe', 'Transporteur indépendant.'],
    'HMIDA' => ['Hmida (camion)', 'externe', 'Transporteur indépendant.'],
    'KHALED' => ['Khaled (camion)', 'externe', 'Transporteur indépendant.'],
    'RAWED' => ['Rawed', 'externe', 'Transporteur.'],
    'MOURAD' => ['Mourad', 'externe', 'Transporteur.'],
];

/** Machines citées dans les fichiers => nom exact du produit au catalogue. */
const XL_PRODUCTS = [
    '/BT ?5100/' => 'TAPIS PRO BT 5100', '/BT ?5700/' => 'TAPIS PRO BT 5700', '/BT ?6100/' => 'TAPIS PRO BT 6100',
    '/BT ?500/' => 'TAPIS ROULANT BT 500+', '/BT ?400/' => 'BT 400+', '/BT ?320|(?<![0-9])320 ?\+/' => 'BT 320 +',
    '/BT ?200|(?<![0-9])200 ?\+/' => 'BT 200+', '/815/' => 'HIT UP SPORT 815 DS', '/8091/' => 'TAPIS ROULANT HIT UP SPORT',
    '/SPEED ?RUN/' => 'HITUP-SPEED RUN inclinaison automatique - 120Kg', '/TITA?N/' => 'HIT UP SPORT TITNAUIM 2.5 HP / 130 KG',
    // « BABDIDA B2 » = tapis B2 ; « BABDIDA » seul = B1
    '/\bB1\b|BAB ?DIDA(?!.*\bB ?[2-4]\b)/' => 'TAPIS B1-BABDIDA',
    '/(?<!VELO )\bB ?2\b(?! ?0)/' => 'TAPIS B2 120KG - AUTO INCLINE', '/AVON|(?<!VELO )\bB ?3\b(?! ?0)/' => 'TAPIS ROULANT B3-AVON FITNESS',
    '/\bB ?4\b(?! ?0)/' => 'TAPIS 140 KG B4', '/VELO.*\bB ?20\b/' => 'VELO B 20', '/VELO.*\bB ?30\b/' => 'VELO B 30',
    '/\bA ?30\b/' => 'Vélo elliptique A30', '/\bE ?20\b/' => 'Vélo elliptique – BT E 20', '/MULTI ?GYM/' => 'MACHINE DE MUSUCLATION-MULTIGYM',
    '/HUILE|LUBRIF/' => 'HUILE LUBRIFIANT TAPIS ROULANT 200ML', '/BARRE ?FIX/' => 'BARREFIXE- PRO', '/CLE DE SECUR/' => 'CLE DE SECURITE STANDARD',
];

function xl_clean($v): string
{
    return trim((string)preg_replace('/\s+/u', ' ', (string)$v));
}

/** Texte en majuscules sans accents ni ponctuation (le « + » est gardé : BT 200+). */
function xl_upper(string $v): string
{
    $s = strtr(mb_strtoupper($v), ['É' => 'E', 'È' => 'E', 'Ê' => 'E', 'Ë' => 'E', 'À' => 'A', 'Â' => 'A', 'Î' => 'I', 'Ï' => 'I', 'Ô' => 'O', 'Ù' => 'U', 'Û' => 'U', 'Ç' => 'C']);
    return ' ' . trim((string)preg_replace('/[^A-Z0-9+]+/', ' ', $s)) . ' ';
}

/**
 * Montant écrit à la main -> millimes : « 3790 DT », « 1,520,000 », « 2.050.000 », « 100.000 » (= 100 DT),
 * « 74.87 », « 1300dt twali 1241dt » (= 1241 DT). null si aucun nombre.
 */
function xl_money(string $v): ?int
{
    $s = xl_clean($v);
    if ($s === '' || !preg_match_all('/\d[\d.,]*/', $s, $m)) return null;
    $tok = rtrim(preg_match('/twali|devient|=>|→/iu', $s) ? end($m[0]) : $m[0][0], '.,');
    if (preg_match('/^\d{1,3}([.,]\d{3}){2,}$/', $tok)) return (int)preg_replace('/\D/', '', $tok);
    if (preg_match('/^(\d+)[.,](\d{3})$/', $tok, $mm)) {
        $x = (int)$mm[1];
        return $x < 10 ? (int)($mm[1] . $mm[2]) * 1000 : $x * 1000 + (int)$mm[2];
    }
    if (preg_match('/^(\d+)[.,](\d{1,2})$/', $tok, $mm)) return (int)round((float)($mm[1] . '.' . $mm[2]) * 1000);
    if (preg_match('/^\d+$/', $tok)) {
        $n = (int)$tok;
        return $n >= 100000 ? $n : $n * 1000;
    }
    return null;
}

/** Téléphones d'une cellule (« 55,770,473//50,460,519 », « 95,262,797 93,805,107 sa mère ») + texte restant. */
function xl_phones(string $v): array
{
    $s = preg_replace('/(?<=\d)[.,](?=\d)/', '', $v);
    preg_match_all('/\d{7,12}/', $s, $m);
    $phones = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map('normalize_phone', $m[0]))));
    $rest = xl_clean(preg_replace('/[\d\/\-.,+]+/', ' ', $s));
    return [$phones, preg_match('/\pL{2,}/u', $rest) ? $rest : ''];
}

/** Produit du catalogue correspondant au texte (un seul produit reconnu), sinon null. */
function xl_match_product(string $label, int $price = 0): ?array
{
    static $byName = null;
    if ($byName === null) {
        $byName = [];
        foreach (all('SELECT id, name, price, promo_price, cost, warranty_months FROM products') as $p) $byName[mb_strtolower($p['name'])][] = $p;
    }
    $parts = array_filter(array_map('trim', explode('/', preg_replace('/\bFAC\s?\d+\b/i', '', $label))), fn($p) => preg_match('/[A-Za-z0-9]{2,}/', $p));
    if (count($parts) !== 1) return null;
    $u = xl_upper((string)reset($parts));
    $found = [];
    foreach (XL_PRODUCTS as $re => $name) if (preg_match($re, $u)) $found[$name] = true;
    if (!$found && preg_match('/HIT ?UP/', $u)) $found['TAPIS ROULANT HIT UP SPORT'] = true;
    if (count($found) !== 1) return null;
    $cands = $byName[mb_strtolower((string)array_key_first($found))] ?? [];
    if (!$cands) return null;
    usort($cands, fn($a, $b) => abs((int)$a['price'] - $price) <=> abs((int)$b['price'] - $price));
    return $cands[0];
}

/** Transporteur cité dans un texte : [id, nom] (créé s'il n'existe pas encore), ou [null, '']. */
function xl_carrier(string $text, bool $driverColumn = false): array
{
    $u = xl_upper($text);
    foreach (XL_CARRIERS as $re => [$name, $type, $note]) {
        if (!preg_match('/' . $re . '/', $u)) continue;
        return [xl_carrier_id($name, $type, $note), $name];
    }
    if (!$driverColumn) return [null, ''];
    // Colonne « TRANSPORTEUR » : « OMAR 180dt » = Omar Kouki ; un autre nom (« HAMADI : 300 DT ») devient un transporteur
    if (preg_match('/\bOMAR\b/', $u)) return [xl_carrier_id('Omar Kouki (camion)', 'externe', 'Transporteur indépendant.'), 'Omar Kouki (camion)'];
    [$person] = xl_person($text);
    if ($person === '' || preg_match('/^(retour|livr|client|patron|depot|dépôt)/iu', $person)) return [null, ''];
    $name = $person . ' (camion)';
    return [xl_carrier_id($name, 'externe', 'Transporteur indépendant.'), $name];
}

function xl_carrier_id(string $name, string $type, string $note): int
{
    $id = val('SELECT id FROM carriers WHERE name = ? COLLATE NOCASE', [$name]);
    if ($id) return (int)$id;
    return insert('carriers', ['name' => $name, 'type' => $type, 'phone' => '', 'contact' => '', 'zones' => '', 'default_fee' => 0, 'cod' => 1,
        'notes' => $note . ' Ajouté par l’import Excel.', 'active' => 1, 'created_at' => now()]);
}

/** Le texte cite-t-il un transporteur connu (sans en créer) ? */
function xl_carrier_known(string $text): bool
{
    $u = xl_upper($text);
    foreach (array_keys(XL_CARRIERS) as $re) if (preg_match('/' . $re . '/', $u)) return true;
    return false;
}

/** « ROSTOM :60 DT » / « ILYES 20DT » / « omar » -> ['Rostom', 60000] ; une phrase n'est pas un nom (['', 0]). */
function xl_person(string $text): array
{
    $t = xl_clean($text);
    if ($t === '' || !preg_match('/\pL/u', $t)) return ['', 0];
    $name = xl_clean(preg_split('/[:\d]/u', $t)[0]);
    $name = mb_convert_case(mb_strtolower(rtrim($name, ' :-')), MB_CASE_TITLE);
    $name = strtr($name, ['Rostem' => 'Rostom', 'Ilyess' => 'Ilyes']);
    if ($name === '' || mb_strlen($name) > 20 || count(explode(' ', $name)) > 2 || preg_match('/^(livr|client|non |annul|echange|échange|retour|ok)/iu', $name)) {
        return ['', 0];
    }
    return [mb_substr($name, 0, 60), xl_money($t) ?? 0];
}

/** Adresse sans les cellules remplies de virgules (« ,,,,,,, »). */
function xl_address(string $v): string
{
    $v = xl_clean(trim($v, " ,.;-"));
    return preg_match('/[\pL\d]/u', $v) ? $v : '';
}

/** Retrouve (par téléphone, sinon par nom + adresse) ou crée le client d'une ligne. */
function xl_client(string $name, array $phones, string $address, string $mf = '', ?string $date = null): ?int
{
    $phone = $phones[0] ?? '';
    if ($name === '' && $phone === '') return null;
    $gouv = guess_gouvernorat($address);
    $ex = $phone !== '' ? one('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE phone = ? OR (phone2 = ? AND phone2 <> \'\')', [$phone, $phone])
        : one("SELECT * FROM clients WHERE name = ? COLLATE NOCASE AND phone = '' AND address = ? COLLATE NOCASE", [$name, $address]);
    if ($ex) {
        $upd = [];
        if ($name !== '' && (str_starts_with($ex['name'], 'Client ') || $ex['name'] === '')) $upd['name'] = $name;
        if (($phones[1] ?? '') !== '' && $ex['phone2'] === '' && $phones[1] !== $ex['phone']) $upd['phone2'] = $phones[1];
        if ($address !== '' && $ex['address'] === '') $upd['address'] = $address;
        if ($gouv !== '' && $ex['gouvernorat'] === '') $upd['gouvernorat'] = $gouv;
        if ($mf !== '' && ($ex['mf'] ?? '') === '') $upd['mf'] = mb_substr($mf, 0, 60);
        if ($upd) update('clients', $upd + ['updated_at' => now()], 'id = ?', [$ex['id']]);
        return (int)$ex['id'];
    }
    return insert('clients', [
        'name' => $name !== '' ? mb_substr($name, 0, 120) : 'Client ' . $phone, 'phone' => $phone, 'phone2' => $phones[1] ?? '',
        'gouvernorat' => $gouv, 'city' => '', 'address' => mb_substr($address, 0, 300), 'mf' => mb_substr($mf, 0, 60), 'source' => '',
        'notes' => 'Créé par l’import Excel.', 'created_at' => ($date ?: today()) . ' 12:00:00', 'updated_at' => now(),
    ]);
}

function xl_location(): ?int
{
    $id = val("SELECT id FROM locations WHERE code = 'TUN'") ?: val("SELECT id FROM locations WHERE type = 'showroom' ORDER BY position, id LIMIT 1");
    return $id ? (int)$id : null;
}

/** Type de fichier d'après son titre et ses en-têtes. */
function xl_detect(array $sheets): ?string
{
    $txt = '';
    foreach (array_slice($sheets, 0, 2) as $sh) foreach (array_slice($sh['rows'], 0, 4, true) as $cells) $txt .= ' ' . implode(' ', $cells);
    $u = xl_upper($txt);
    if (preg_match('/\bPANNE\b|REPARATION|APRES VENTE|REPARATEUR/', $u)) return 'reparations';
    if (preg_match('/\bPAIEMENT\b/', $u) || (str_contains($u, ' TRANSPORT ') && preg_match('/\bPAYE\b/', $u))) return 'paiements';
    if (preg_match('/\bVENTE\b/', $u) || (str_contains($u, ' MACHINE ') && str_contains($u, ' TOTAL '))) return 'ventes';
    return null;
}

/** Ligne d'en-têtes : première ligne contenant tous les mots demandés. */
function xl_header_row(array $rows, array $words): ?int
{
    foreach (array_slice($rows, 0, 12, true) as $n => $cells) {
        $u = xl_upper(implode(' | ', $cells));
        $ok = true;
        foreach ($words as $w) if (!str_contains($u, ' ' . $w . ' ')) { $ok = false; break; }
        if ($ok) return (int)$n;
    }
    return null;
}

/** Référence anti-doublon : clé lisible + n° d'occurrence (deux lignes identiques le même jour restent distinctes). */
function xl_ref(array &$seen, string ...$parts): string
{
    $key = implode('|', array_map(fn($p) => slug_key((string)$p), $parts));
    $seen[$key] = ($seen[$key] ?? 0) + 1;
    return mb_substr($key, 0, 240) . '#' . $seen[$key];
}

/**
 * Importe (ou simule, si $commit est faux) un classeur. Retourne un rapport :
 * kind, label, sheets [nom => lignes], rows, created [type => n], updated, unchanged, skipped, warnings[], unmatched[], amount.
 */
function xl_import(string $file, bool $commit, ?string $kind = null): array
{
    $sheets = xlsx_read($file);
    $kind = $kind ?: xl_detect($sheets);
    if (!$kind || !isset(XL_KINDS[$kind])) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Fichier non reconnu : seuls les classeurs « VENTE GRAND TUNIS », « PAIEMENT » et « RÉPARATION ET SERVICE APRÈS VENTE » sont pris en charge ici. Pour les autres données, utilisez les imports CSV ci-dessous.');
    }
    $rep = ['kind' => $kind, 'label' => XL_KINDS[$kind], 'sheets' => [], 'rows' => 0, 'created' => [], 'updated' => 0, 'unchanged' => 0,
        'skipped' => 0, 'warnings' => [], 'unmatched' => [], 'amount' => 0];
    $pdo = db();
    $pdo->beginTransaction();
    try {
        $before = ['clients' => (int)val('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clients'), 'transporteurs' => (int)val('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carriers')];
        if ($kind === 'ventes') xl_import_ventes($sheets, $rep);
        elseif ($kind === 'paiements') xl_import_paiements($sheets, $rep);
        else xl_import_reparations($sheets, $rep);
        foreach ($before as $k => $n) if (($d = (int)val('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ' . ($k === 'clients' ? 'clients' : 'carriers')) - $n) > 0) $rep['created'][$k] = $d;
        arsort($rep['unmatched']);
        $rep['unmatched'] = array_slice($rep['unmatched'], 0, 15, true);
        $rep['warnings'] = array_slice($rep['warnings'], 0, 60);
        if ($commit) {
            $created = implode(', ', array_map(fn($k, $n) => "$n $k", array_keys($rep['created']), $rep['created']));
            audit('import Excel', $kind, null, XL_KINDS[$kind] . ' · ' . ($created ?: 'rien de nouveau') . " · {$rep['updated']} mise(s) à jour");
            $pdo->commit();
        } else {
            $pdo->rollBack();
        }
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        if ($pdo->inTransaction()) $pdo->rollBack();
        throw $e;
    }
    return $rep;
}

function xl_count(array &$rep, string $what, int $n = 1): void
{
    $rep['created'][$what] = ($rep['created'][$what] ?? 0) + $n;
}

/* ---------- VENTE GRAND TUNIS ---------- */

function xl_import_ventes(array $sheets, array &$rep): void
{
    $loc = xl_location();
    $uid = user()['id'] ?? null;
    $seen = [];
    foreach ($sheets as $sheet) {
        $rows = $sheet['rows'];
        $hdr = xl_header_row($rows, ['DATE', 'TOTAL']);
        if ($hdr === null) {
            if ($rows) $rep['warnings'][] = "Feuille « {$sheet['name']} » : ligne d’en-têtes (DATE, TOTAL…) introuvable, feuille ignorée.";
            continue;
        }
        $cols = [];
        foreach ($rows[$hdr] as $c => $label) {
            $u = xl_upper($label);
            // « FRAIS DE TRANSPORT PAYÉ PAR LE CLIENT » contient « CLIENT » : FRAIS est testé en premier
            $k = match (true) {
                str_contains($u, ' FRAIS ') => 'fees', str_contains($u, ' TRANSPORTEUR ') => 'driver',
                str_contains($u, ' DATE ') => 'date', str_contains($u, ' MACHINE ') => 'machine',
                str_contains($u, ' MATRICULE ') || trim($u) === 'MF' => 'mf', str_contains($u, ' NUM') => 'phone',
                str_contains($u, ' NOM ') || str_contains($u, ' CLIENT ') => 'client', str_contains($u, ' ADRESSE ') => 'address',
                str_contains($u, ' TOTAL ') => 'total', str_contains($u, ' FRAIS ') => 'fees', str_contains($u, ' TECHNICIEN ') => 'tech',
                str_contains($u, ' TRANSPORTEUR ') => 'driver', str_contains($u, ' TARIF ') => 'tarif', str_contains($u, ' HMIDA ') => 'hmida',
                default => null,
            };
            if ($k && !isset($cols[$k])) $cols[$k] = (int)$c;
        }
        // La colonne des frais est souvent fusionnée avec la suivante (« LIVRÉ », « BEST DELIVERY »…)
        $fees2 = isset($cols['fees']) && !in_array($cols['fees'] + 1, $cols, true) ? $cols['fees'] + 1 : null;
        $month = preg_match('/(\d{1,2})\D+(20\d\d)/', $sheet['name'], $m) ? sprintf('%04d-%02d', $m[2], $m[1]) : null;
        $last = null;
        $n = 0;
        foreach ($rows as $line => $cells) {
            if ($line <= $hdr) continue;
            try {
            $g = fn(string $k) => isset($cols[$k]) ? xl_clean($cells[$cols[$k]] ?? '') : '';
            $date = xlsx_date($g('date'));
            // Date tapée avec une erreur (autre mois que la feuille) : on garde la date précédente
            if ($date && $month && abs((strtotime($date) - strtotime($month . '-15')) / 86400) > 62) $date = null;
            if ($date) $last = $date;
            $date = $date ?: ($last ?: ($month ? $month . '-01' : today()));
            $machine = $g('machine');
            $client = $g('client');
            $phoneTxt = $g('phone');
            $address = xl_address($g('address'));
            $totalTxt = $g('total');
            $fees = xl_clean($g('fees') . ' ' . ($fees2 ? ($cells[$fees2] ?? '') : ''));
            $tech = $g('tech');
            $driver = $g('driver');
            $hmida = $g('hmida');
            if ($machine === '' && $client === '' && $phoneTxt === '' && $totalTxt === '' && $address === '') {
                // Ligne de frais seule (« 50 DT HMIDA ») : dépense de transport du jour
                $feeTxt = $driver ?: ($hmida !== '' ? $hmida . ' HMIDA' : $tech);
                $amount = $feeTxt !== '' ? (int)(xl_money($feeTxt) ?? 0) : 0;
                if ($amount <= 0) { if ($fees . $tech . $driver . $hmida !== '') $rep['skipped']++; continue; }
                $rep['rows']++;
                [, $cname] = xl_carrier($feeTxt, true);
                $ref = xl_ref($seen, 'vente-frais', $date, $feeTxt);
                if (val('SELECT id FROM expenses WHERE import_ref = ?', [$ref])) { $rep['unchanged']++; continue; }
                insert('expenses', ['date' => $date, 'location_id' => $loc, 'category' => 'transport',
                    'label' => 'Transport' . ($cname ? ' — ' . $cname : '') . ' (fichier VENTE GRAND TUNIS)', 'amount' => $amount, 'method' => 'especes',
                    'supplier' => $cname, 'reference' => '', 'note' => $feeTxt, 'user_id' => $uid, 'created_at' => now(), 'import_ref' => $ref]);
                xl_count($rep, 'dépenses de transport');
                continue;
            }
            $rep['rows']++;
            $n++;
            $total = (int)(xl_money($totalTxt) ?? 0);
            [$phones, $phoneNote] = xl_phones($phoneTxt);
            $ref = xl_ref($seen, 'vente', $date, $client ?: $address, $machine, (string)$total);
            if (val('SELECT id FROM sales WHERE import_ref = ?', [$ref]) || val('SELECT id FROM shipments WHERE import_ref = ?', [$ref . '|liv'])) {
                $rep['unchanged']++;
                continue;
            }
            $clientId = xl_client($client, $phones, $address, $g('mf'), $date);
            $inv = preg_match('/\bFAC\s?(\d+)/i', $machine, $mm) ? 'FAC' . $mm[1] : '';
            $label = xl_clean(preg_replace('/^\s*FAC\s?\d+\s*[\/:\-]?\s*/i', '', $machine)) ?: ($machine ?: 'Vente');
            $p = xl_match_product($label, $total);
            if (!$p && $label !== '') $rep['unmatched'][$label] = ($rep['unmatched'][$label] ?? 0) + 1;

            // Livraison : transporteur (société citée dans les frais, sinon camion de la colonne TRANSPORTEUR), technicien, frais
            $pickup = (bool)preg_match('/retrait/i', $fees . ' ' . $tech . ' ' . $driver);
            [$carrierId, $carrierName] = xl_carrier($fees);
            // Un transporteur noté dans la colonne TECHNICIEN (« Transporteur khaled : 60 DT », « HMIDA ») reste un transporteur
            $techIsDriver = $tech !== '' && (preg_match('/transporteur/i', $tech) || xl_carrier_known($tech));
            $driverTxt = $driver !== '' ? $driver : ($hmida !== '' ? 'HMIDA ' . $hmida : ($techIsDriver ? $tech : ''));
            [$driverId, $driverName] = $driverTxt !== '' ? xl_carrier($driverTxt, true) : [null, ''];
            if (!$carrierId) [$carrierId, $carrierName] = [$driverId, $driverName];
            $carrierFee = $driverTxt !== '' ? (int)(xl_money($driverTxt) ?? 0) : 0;
            [$techName, $techFee] = $techIsDriver || preg_match('/retrait/i', $tech) ? ['', 0] : xl_person($tech);
            $clientFee = (int)(xl_money($fees) ?? 0);
            // « TPS (RETOUR) bien reçu » : livraison revenue (client absent, produit endommagé…) = vente annulée, pas d'argent
            $retour = (bool)preg_match('/retour/i', $fees);
            // Retour « bien reçu », ou ancien (plus de 30 jours) : la marchandise est revenue au dépôt
            $backHome = $retour && (preg_match('/re[cç]u/iu', $fees) || $date < date('Y-m-d', strtotime('-30 days')));
            $notes = array_filter([
                $inv ? 'Facture ' . $inv : '', $g('tarif') !== '' ? 'Tarif : ' . $g('tarif') : '', $phoneNote,
                "Importé du fichier Excel « VENTE GRAND TUNIS » (feuille {$sheet['name']}, ligne $line).",
            ]);

            $saleId = null;
            if ($total > 0) {
                $year = substr($date, 0, 4);
                $number = 'XL-' . substr($year, 2) . '-' . str_pad((string)next_seq('sale:XL:' . $year), 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
                $at = $date . ' 12:00:00';
                $saleId = insert('sales', [
                    'number' => $number, 'location_id' => $loc, 'session_id' => null, 'user_id' => $uid, 'client_id' => $clientId,
                    'created_at' => $at, 'subtotal' => $total, 'discount' => 0, 'total' => $total, 'paid' => $retour ? 0 : $total, 'catalog_total' => $total,
                    'status' => $retour ? 'annulee' : 'payee', 'source' => '', 'note' => mb_substr(implode(' · ', $notes), 0, 500), 'import_ref' => $ref,
                ] + ($retour ? ['cancelled_at' => $date . ' 18:00:00', 'cancelled_by' => $uid, 'cancel_reason' => mb_substr('Retour transporteur : ' . $fees, 0, 300)] : []));
                insert('sale_items', ['sale_id' => $saleId, 'product_id' => $p['id'] ?? null, 'label' => mb_substr($p['name'] ?? $label, 0, 120), 'qty' => 1,
                    'unit_price' => $total, 'list_price' => $total, 'unit_cost' => isset($p['cost']) ? (int)$p['cost'] : null, 'vat_rate' => (float)setting('vat_rate', 19),
                    'total' => $total, 'warranty_months' => $p['warranty_months'] ?? null]);
                if (!$retour) {
                    insert('payments', ['sale_id' => $saleId, 'session_id' => null, 'location_id' => $loc, 'created_at' => $at,
                        'method' => $carrierId && !$pickup ? 'cod' : 'especes', 'amount' => $total, 'reference' => 'Import Excel', 'user_id' => $uid]);
                    $rep['amount'] += $total;
                }
                xl_count($rep, $retour ? 'ventes annulées (retour)' : 'ventes');
            } elseif ($totalTxt === '') {
                $rep['warnings'][] = "Feuille {$sheet['name']}, ligne $line : montant absent (« " . mb_substr($machine ?: $client, 0, 50) . ' ») — livraison enregistrée sans vente.';
            }
            if (!$pickup && ($address !== '' || $carrierId || $techName !== '')) {
                $status = $retour ? 'retour' : 'livree';
                $shId = shipment_create([
                    'sale_id' => $saleId, 'client_id' => $clientId, 'location_id' => $loc, 'carrier_id' => $carrierId,
                    'recipient' => $client !== '' ? $client : ($address !== '' ? $address : 'Client'), 'phone' => $phones[0] ?? '',
                    'gouvernorat' => guess_gouvernorat($address), 'city' => '', 'address' => $address, 'status' => $status,
                    'holder' => $backHome ? 'depart' : ship_holder_for_status($status),
                    'holder_note' => $backHome ? (preg_match('/re[cç]u/iu', $fees) ? 'Retour reçu au dépôt' : 'Revenue au dépôt (retour ancien du fichier Excel)') :($driverName && $driverName !== $carrierName ? 'Camion : ' . $driverName : ''),
                    'tracking' => '', 'fee' => $carrierFee, 'cod_amount' => $saleId && $carrierId && !$retour ? $total : 0, 'cod_collected' => $retour ? 0 : 1,
                    'client_fee' => $clientFee, 'technician' => $techName, 'technician_fee' => $techFee,
                    'planned_date' => $date, 'delivered_at' => $status === 'livree' ? $date . ' 18:00:00' : null,
                    'note' => mb_substr(implode(' · ', array_filter([$fees !== '' ? 'Frais : ' . $fees : '', $driver !== '' ? 'Transporteur : ' . $driver : '', $tech !== '' ? 'Technicien : ' . $tech : ''])), 0, 500),
                    'created_at' => $date . ' 12:00:00', 'updated_at' => $date . ' 18:00:00', 'import_ref' => $ref . '|liv',
                ], $saleId ? null : [['product_id' => $p['id'] ?? null, 'label' => $p['name'] ?? $label, 'qty' => 1]], 'Importée du fichier Excel « VENTE GRAND TUNIS »');
                if ($status === 'livree') shipment_event($shId, 'Livrée' . ($techName ? ' et installée par ' . $techName : ''), 'ok', $date . ' 18:00:00');
                else shipment_event($shId, 'Retour / échec de livraison' . ($backHome ? ' · marchandise revenue au dépôt' : ''), 'err', $date . ' 18:00:00');
                xl_count($rep, 'livraisons');
            }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Feuille « {$sheet['name']} », ligne $line : " . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
            }
        }
        $rep['sheets'][$sheet['name']] = $n;
    }
}

/* ---------- PAIEMENT (transporteurs) ---------- */

function xl_import_paiements(array $sheets, array &$rep): void
{
    $loc = xl_location();
    $seen = [];
    foreach ($sheets as $sheet) {
        $rows = $sheet['rows'];
        $hdr = xl_header_row($rows, ['CLIENT', 'TRANSPORT']);
        if ($hdr === null) continue;
        $cols = [];
        foreach ($rows[$hdr] as $c => $label) {
            $u = xl_upper($label);
            $k = match (true) {
                str_contains($u, ' DATE ') => 'date', str_contains($u, ' REFERENCE ') => 'ref', str_contains($u, ' CLIENT ') => 'client',
                str_contains($u, ' MONTANT ') => 'amount', str_contains($u, ' ADRESSE ') => 'address', str_contains($u, ' TRANSPORT ') => 'carrier',
                str_contains($u, ' NON PAYE ') => 'unpaid', str_contains($u, ' PAYE ') => 'paid', str_contains($u, ' MACHINE ') => 'machine',
                default => null,
            };
            if ($k && !isset($cols[$k])) $cols[$k] = (int)$c;
        }
        $last = null;
        $n = 0;
        foreach ($rows as $line => $cells) {
            if ($line <= $hdr) continue;
            try {
            $g = fn(string $k) => isset($cols[$k]) ? xl_clean($cells[$cols[$k]] ?? '') : '';
            $refTxt = $g('ref');
            $client = $g('client');
            $amountTxt = $g('amount');
            $address = xl_address($g('address'));
            if ($refTxt === '' && $client === '' && $amountTxt === '' && $address === '') { if (count($cells)) $rep['skipped']++; continue; }
            $date = xlsx_date($g('date'));
            if ($date) $last = $date;
            $date = $date ?: ($last ?: today());
            $rep['rows']++;
            $n++;
            $tracking = preg_match('/^\s*(T?\d[\d\/]*)/i', $refTxt, $m) ? strtoupper($m[1]) : '';
            $label = xl_clean(trim(substr($refTxt, strlen($m[0] ?? '')))) ?: $g('machine');
            $amount = (int)(xl_money($amountTxt) ?? 0);
            [$carrierId, $carrierName] = xl_carrier($g('carrier'));
            if (!$carrierId && $g('carrier') !== '') {
                $name = mb_convert_case(mb_strtolower($g('carrier')), MB_CASE_TITLE);
                $carrierId = xl_carrier_id($name, 'externe', 'Transporteur.');
                $carrierName = $name;
            }
            $st = mb_strtolower($g('paid') . ' ' . $g('unpaid'));
            $note = '';
            if (str_contains($st, 'retour')) { $status = 'retour'; $collected = 0; $note = 'Retour (fichier PAIEMENT)'; }
            elseif (preg_match('/vir|vair/u', $st)) { $status = 'livree'; $collected = 1; $note = 'Payé par virement bancaire'; }
            elseif (str_contains($st, 'achat')) { $status = 'livree'; $collected = 1; $note = 'Achat machine'; }
            elseif (preg_match('/pay|pai/u', $st)) { $status = 'livree'; $collected = 1; }
            elseif (str_contains($st, 'livr')) { $status = 'livree'; $collected = 0; $note = 'Livré, argent pas encore reçu du transporteur'; }
            else { $status = 'en_cours'; $collected = 0; $note = 'En attente (fichier PAIEMENT : ni payé ni retour)'; }
            if ($amount === 0) $collected = 1;
            $ref = xl_ref($seen, 'paiement', $date, $refTxt, $client);

            $ex = one('SELECT * FROM shipments WHERE import_ref = ?', [$ref]);
            if ($ex) {
                // Réimport : le statut a pu évoluer (en attente -> payé, livré -> payé…)
                $changed = false;
                if ($ex['status'] !== $status) { shipment_set_status($ex, $status, null, 'mise à jour depuis le fichier PAIEMENT'); $changed = true; }
                if ($collected && !$ex['cod_collected']) { shipment_collect(one('SELECT * FROM shipments WHERE id = ?', [$ex['id']])); $changed = true; }
                $rep[$changed ? 'updated' : 'unchanged']++;
                continue;
            }
            // Vente correspondante (fichier VENTE GRAND TUNIS déjà importé) : même client, même montant, ±45 jours
            $sale = null;
            if ($client !== '' && $amount > 0) {
                foreach (all("SELECT s.*, c.name cname FROM sales s JOIN clients c ON c.id = s.client_id WHERE s.import_ref IS NOT NULL AND s.total = ?
                        AND date(s.created_at) BETWEEN date(?, '-45 days') AND date(?, '+45 days')", [$amount, $date, $date]) as $s) {
                    if (slug_key($s['cname']) === slug_key($client)) { $sale = $s; break; }
                }
            }
            $data = ['carrier_id' => $carrierId, 'tracking' => $tracking, 'cod_amount' => $amount, 'status' => $status, 'holder' => ship_holder_for_status($status),
                'delivered_at' => $status === 'livree' ? $date . ' 18:00:00' : null, 'import_ref' => $ref];
            $shId = null;
            if ($sale && ($sh = one('SELECT * FROM shipments WHERE sale_id = ? ORDER BY id LIMIT 1', [$sale['id']])) && !str_starts_with((string)$sh['import_ref'], 'paiement')) {
                update('shipments', $data + ['cod_collected' => $collected, 'note' => trim($sh['note'] . ' · ' . $note . ' (fichier PAIEMENT)', ' ·'), 'updated_at' => now()], 'id = ?', [$sh['id']]);
                shipment_event((int)$sh['id'], 'Fichier PAIEMENT : ' . ($note ?: ($collected ? 'payé' : SHIP_STATUS[$status])) . ($carrierName ? ' · ' . $carrierName : ''), $collected ? 'ok' : 'info');
                $shId = (int)$sh['id'];
                xl_count($rep, 'livraisons rapprochées d’une vente');
            } else {
                [$phones] = xl_phones('');
                $clientId = $client !== '' ? xl_client($client, $phones, $address, '', $date) : null;
                $p = $label !== '' ? xl_match_product($label, $amount) : null;
                $shId = shipment_create([
                    'sale_id' => $sale['id'] ?? null, 'client_id' => $clientId ?: ($sale['client_id'] ?? null), 'location_id' => $loc,
                    'recipient' => $client !== '' ? $client : ($address ?: 'Client'), 'phone' => '', 'gouvernorat' => guess_gouvernorat($address),
                    'city' => '', 'address' => $address, 'cod_collected' => $collected, 'fee' => 0, 'planned_date' => $date,
                    'note' => mb_substr(trim($note . ' · Importé du fichier Excel « PAIEMENT » (ligne ' . $line . ').', ' ·'), 0, 500),
                    'created_at' => $date . ' 12:00:00', 'updated_at' => $date . ' 12:00:00',
                ] + $data, $sale ? null : ($label !== '' ? [['product_id' => $p['id'] ?? null, 'label' => $p['name'] ?? $label, 'qty' => 1]] : []),
                    'Remise au transporteur' . ($tracking ? ' (n° ' . $tracking . ')' : ''));
                if ($status === 'livree') shipment_event($shId, $collected ? 'Livrée · argent récupéré' . ($note ? ' (' . mb_strtolower($note) . ')' : '') : 'Livrée · argent à récupérer', $collected ? 'ok' : 'info', $date . ' 18:00:00');
                if ($status === 'retour') shipment_event($shId, 'Retour / échec de livraison', 'err', $date . ' 18:00:00');
                xl_count($rep, 'livraisons');
            }
            // Vente rapprochée mais argent pas reçu : le paiement « contre-remboursement » supposé à l'import des ventes est retiré
            if ($sale && !$collected) {
                $removed = (int)val("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM payments WHERE sale_id = ? AND reference = 'Import Excel'", [$sale['id']]);
                if ($removed) {
                    q("DELETE FROM payments WHERE sale_id = ? AND reference = 'Import Excel'", [$sale['id']]);
                    $paid = (int)val('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM payments WHERE sale_id = ?', [$sale['id']]);
                    update('sales', ['paid' => $paid, 'status' => $paid >= (int)$sale['total'] ? 'payee' : 'partielle'], 'id = ?', [$sale['id']]);
                }
            }
            if ($amount > 0) $rep['amount'] += $amount;
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Feuille « {$sheet['name']} », ligne $line : " . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
            }
        }
        $rep['sheets'][$sheet['name']] = $n;
    }
}

/* ---------- RÉPARATION ET SERVICE APRÈS VENTE ---------- */

function xl_import_reparations(array $sheets, array &$rep): void
{
    $loc = xl_location();
    $seen = [];
    foreach ($sheets as $sheet) {
        $rows = $sheet['rows'];
        $hdr = xl_header_row($rows, ['PANNE']) ?? xl_header_row($rows, ['PRODUIT']);
        if ($hdr === null) continue;
        $cols = [];
        foreach ($rows[$hdr] as $c => $label) {
            $u = xl_upper($label);
            $k = match (true) {
                str_contains($u, ' DATE ') => 'date', str_contains($u, ' NOM ') || str_contains($u, ' CLIENT ') => 'client',
                str_contains($u, ' NUM') || str_contains($u, ' TEL') => 'phone', str_contains($u, ' ADRESSE ') => 'address',
                str_contains($u, ' PRODUIT ') || str_contains($u, ' MACHINE ') => 'product', str_contains($u, ' PANNE ') => 'issue',
                str_contains($u, ' REPARATEUR ') || str_contains($u, ' TECHNICIEN ') => 'tech', str_contains($u, ' STATUT ') => 'status',
                (bool)preg_match('/^ R | S A V | SAV /', $u) => 'kind',
                default => null,
            };
            if ($k && !isset($cols[$k])) $cols[$k] = (int)$c;
        }
        $known = array_values($cols);
        $n = 0;
        foreach ($rows as $line => $cells) {
            if ($line <= $hdr) continue;
            try {
            $g = fn(string $k) => isset($cols[$k]) ? xl_clean($cells[$cols[$k]] ?? '') : '';
            // Colonnes sans en-tête (montant payé, diagnostic, rendez-vous…)
            $extra = xl_clean(implode(' · ', array_filter(array_map(fn($c) => xl_clean($c), array_diff_key($cells, array_flip($known))))));
            $client = $g('client');
            $phoneTxt = $g('phone');
            $address = xl_address($g('address'));
            $product = $g('product');
            $issue = $g('issue');
            $statusTxt = $g('status');
            if ($client . $phoneTxt . $address . $product . $issue . $statusTxt === '') {
                if ($extra !== '') $rep['skipped']++; // ligne de total (« total: 360 dt »)
                continue;
            }
            $rep['rows']++;
            $n++;
            [$phones, $phoneNote] = xl_phones($phoneTxt);
            $st = mb_strtolower($statusTxt);
            $money = $statusTxt . ' ' . $extra;
            $amount = (int)(preg_match('/(\d[\d.,]*)\s*(dt|dinar|pay|paye|payé)|(?:pay[ée]?|diagnostique?|r[ée]par[ée])\D{0,6}(\d[\d.,]*)/iu', $money, $mm)
                ? (xl_money($mm[1] !== '' ? $mm[1] : $mm[3]) ?? 0) : 0);
            if (!$amount && preg_match('/^\d+([.,]\d+)?$/', $extra)) $amount = (int)(xl_money($extra) ?? 0);
            $isPaid = (bool)preg_match('/pay/iu', $money);
            $status = match (true) {
                str_contains($st, 'annul') => 'annule', str_contains($st, 'cours') => 'en_cours',
                (bool)preg_match('/r[ée]par/u', $st) => 'repare', $isPaid => 'repare', default => 'nouveau',
            };
            $kind = preg_match('/S\W*A\W*V/i', $g('kind')) ? 'sav' : 'reparation';
            $tech = $g('tech') !== '' ? mb_convert_case(mb_strtolower($g('tech')), MB_CASE_TITLE) : '';
            $p = $product !== '' ? xl_match_product($product) : null;
            $ref = xl_ref($seen, 'reparation', $phones[0] ?? $client, $product, $issue, $address);
            $in = [
                'client_name' => $client, 'phone' => $phones[0] ?? '', 'phone2' => $phones[1] ?? '', 'address' => $address, 'gouvernorat' => '',
                'product' => $product, 'product_id' => $p['id'] ?? null, 'issue' => $issue, 'kind' => $kind, 'technician' => $tech,
                'status' => $status, 'place' => preg_match('/ram[eè]n|atelier|tjib|chijib|ychijib|men seilana/iu', $issue . ' ' . $address) ? 'atelier' : 'domicile',
                'amount' => $amount, 'paid' => $isPaid ? $amount : 0,
                'note' => mb_substr(implode(' · ', array_filter([$phoneNote, $extra, $statusTxt !== '' && $amount ? $statusTxt : '', 'Importé du fichier Excel (ligne ' . $line . ').'])), 0, 1000),
                'location_id' => $loc, 'import_ref' => $ref,
            ];
            $ex = one('SELECT * FROM repairs WHERE import_ref = ?', [$ref]);
            if ($ex) {
                if ($ex['status'] !== $status || (int)$ex['amount'] !== $amount || (int)$ex['paid'] !== $in['paid'] || $ex['technician'] !== $tech) {
                    repair_save(['note' => $ex['note'], 'appointment' => $ex['appointment'], 'received_at' => $ex['received_at']] + $in, $ex);
                    $rep['updated']++;
                } else {
                    $rep['unchanged']++;
                }
                continue;
            }
            repair_save($in);
            xl_count($rep, 'réparations');
            $rep['amount'] += $in['paid'];
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Feuille « {$sheet['name']} », ligne $line : " . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
            }
        }
        $rep['sheets'][$sheet['name']] = $n;
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/* ---------- Sortie HTML ---------- */

function e($v): string
{
    return htmlspecialchars((string)($v ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8');
}

/** Montant en millimes -> « 1 999,000 DT ». */
function money($m, bool $unit = true, int $dec = 3): string
{
    $s = number_format(((int)($m ?? 0)) / 1000, $dec, ',', "\u{202F}");
    return $unit ? $s . "\u{00A0}DT" : $s;
}

/** Montant arrondi au dinar pour les tuiles du tableau de bord. */
function money0($m): string
{
    return money($m, true, 0);
}

/** Montant pour un champ de saisie : 1999 / 49,5 / 13,26. */
function m_in($m): string
{
    if ($m === null || $m === '') return '';
    $s = number_format(((int)$m) / 1000, 3, ',', '');
    $s = rtrim(rtrim($s, '0'), ',');
    return $s === '-0' ? '0' : $s;
}

/** « 1 999,000 » / « 1999.5 » / « 49,000 DT » -> millimes (int) ; null si vide ou invalide. */
function parse_money($v): ?int
{
    if ($v === null) return null;
    if (is_int($v)) return $v * 1000;
    if (is_float($v)) return (int)round($v * 1000);
    $s = trim((string)$v);
    $s = str_replace(["\u{00A0}", "\u{202F}", ' ', 'DT', 'dt', 'TND', 'Dt'], '', $s);
    if ($s === '') return null;
    if (strpos($s, ',') !== false && strpos($s, '.') !== false) {
        $s = str_replace('.', '', $s);
    }
    $s = str_replace(',', '.', $s);
    if (!is_numeric($s)) return null;
    return (int)round(((float)$s) * 1000);
}

function parse_int($v, ?int $default = null): ?int
{
    $s = trim(str_replace([' ', "\u{00A0}"], '', (string)($v ?? '')));
    if ($s === '' || !preg_match('/^-?\d+([.,]0+)?$/', $s)) return $default;
    return (int)$s;
}

function fdate(?string $d, bool $time = false): string
{
    if (!$d) return '';
    $t = strtotime($d);
    if ($t === false) return e($d);
    return date($time ? 'd/m/Y H:i' : 'd/m/Y', $t);
}

/** Date saisie en jj/mm/aaaa ou aaaa-mm-jj -> aaaa-mm-jj (ou null). */
function parse_date($v): ?string
{
    $s = trim((string)($v ?? ''));
    if ($s === '') return null;
    if (preg_match('#^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})#', $s, $m)) return sprintf('%04d-%02d-%02d', $m[1], $m[2], $m[3]);
    if (preg_match('#^(\d{1,2})[/.-](\d{1,2})[/.-](\d{4})#', $s, $m)) return sprintf('%04d-%02d-%02d', $m[3], $m[2], $m[1]);
    $t = strtotime($s);
    return $t ? date('Y-m-d', $t) : null;
}

function now(): string
{
    return date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
}

function today(): string
{
    return date('Y-m-d');
}

/* ---------- Requête ---------- */

function is_post(): bool
{
    return ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET') === 'POST';
}

function post(string $k, $default = '')
{
    $v = $_POST[$k] ?? $default;
    return is_string($v) ? trim($v) : $v;
}

function get(string $k, $default = '')
{
    $v = $_GET[$k] ?? $default;
    return is_string($v) ? trim($v) : $v;
}

function url(string $r, array $p = []): string
{
    $q = array_filter(array_merge(['r' => $r], $p), fn($v) => $v !== null && $v !== '');
    return 'index.php?' . http_build_query($q);
}

function redirect(string $to): void
{
    header('Location: ' . $to);
    exit;
}

function back(string $fallback = 'index.php'): void
{
    $ref = $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'] ?? '';
    $host = $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] ?? '';
    if ($ref && $host && parse_url($ref, PHP_URL_HOST) === parse_url('http://' . $host, PHP_URL_HOST)) {
        redirect($ref);
    }
    redirect($fallback);
}

function json_out($data, int $code = 200): void
{
    http_response_code($code);
    header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
    echo json_encode($data, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
    exit;
}

function json_input(): array
{
    $d = json_decode((string)file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
    return is_array($d) ? $d : [];
}

/* ---------- Messages flash ---------- */

function flash(string $type, string $msg): void
{
    $_SESSION['flash'][] = [$type, $msg];
}

function flashes(): array
{
    $f = $_SESSION['flash'] ?? [];
    unset($_SESSION['flash']);
    return $f;
}

/* ---------- CSRF ---------- */

function csrf_token(): string
{
    if (empty($_SESSION['csrf'])) $_SESSION['csrf'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
    return $_SESSION['csrf'];
}

function csrf_field(): string
{
    return '<input type="hidden" name="_csrf" value="' . e(csrf_token()) . '">';
}

function csrf_check(): void
{
    $t = $_POST['_csrf'] ?? ($_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? '');
    if (!is_string($t) || !hash_equals(csrf_token(), $t)) {
        http_response_code(419);
        if (str_contains($_SERVER['HTTP_ACCEPT'] ?? '', 'json') || isset($_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'])) {
            json_out(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Session expirée : rechargez la page.'], 419);
        }
        exit('Session expirée : revenez en arrière et rechargez la page.');
    }
}

/* ---------- Divers ---------- */

function slug_key(string $s): string
{
    $s = mb_strtolower(trim($s));
    $s = strtr($s, ['à' => 'a', 'â' => 'a', 'ä' => 'a', 'á' => 'a', 'ç' => 'c', 'é' => 'e', 'è' => 'e', 'ê' => 'e', 'ë' => 'e',
        'î' => 'i', 'ï' => 'i', 'í' => 'i', 'ô' => 'o', 'ö' => 'o', 'ó' => 'o', 'ù' => 'u', 'û' => 'u', 'ü' => 'u', 'ú' => 'u',
        'ÿ' => 'y', 'œ' => 'oe', 'æ' => 'ae', '’' => '', "'" => '']);
    $s = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]+/', '_', $s);
    return trim($s, '_');
}

function initials(string $name): string
{
    $parts = preg_split('/\s+/', trim($name));
    $i = '';
    foreach ($parts as $p) {
        if (!preg_match('/\pL/u', $p, $m)) continue;
        $i .= mb_strtoupper($m[0]);
        if (mb_strlen($i) >= 2) break;
    }
    return $i ?: '?';
}

function opt(array $options, $selected, bool $blank = false, string $blankLabel = '—'): string
{
    $h = $blank ? '<option value="">' . e($blankLabel) . '</option>' : '';
    foreach ($options as $v => $label) {
        $sel = ((string)$v === (string)$selected) ? ' selected' : '';
        $h .= '<option value="' . e($v) . '"' . $sel . '>' . e($label) . '</option>';
    }
    return $h;
}

function pct(float $v, int $dec = 0): string
{
    return number_format($v, $dec, ',', ' ') . "\u{00A0}%";
}

-- réparations & SAV, imports des fichiers Excel (références anti-doublon).

ALTER TABLE shipments ADD COLUMN holder TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'depart';   -- depart | transporteur | technicien | client | retour
ALTER TABLE shipments ADD COLUMN holder_note TEXT DEFAULT '';             -- précision : « chez TPS Gafsa », « chez Omar »…
ALTER TABLE shipments ADD COLUMN origin_note TEXT DEFAULT '';             -- départ hors showroom : fournisseur, dépôt Mégrine…
ALTER TABLE shipments ADD COLUMN technician TEXT DEFAULT '';              -- installateur / technicien
ALTER TABLE shipments ADD COLUMN technician_fee INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; -- prime du technicien
ALTER TABLE shipments ADD COLUMN client_fee INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;   -- frais de transport payés par le client
ALTER TABLE shipments ADD COLUMN import_ref TEXT;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS shipments_import ON shipments(import_ref) WHERE import_ref IS NOT NULL;
UPDATE shipments SET holder = CASE status WHEN 'en_cours' THEN 'transporteur' WHEN 'livree' THEN 'client' WHEN 'retour' THEN 'retour' ELSE 'depart' END;

-- Marchandise transportée
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shipment_items (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  shipment_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES shipments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  INTEGER REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  label       TEXT NOT NULL,
  qty         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS shipment_items_ship ON shipment_items(shipment_id);
INSERT INTO shipment_items (shipment_id, product_id, label, qty)
  SELECT sh.id, si.product_id, si.label, si.qty FROM shipments sh JOIN sale_items si ON si.sale_id = sh.sale_id;

-- Historique d'une livraison (statut, lieu de la marchandise, argent reçu…)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shipment_events (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  shipment_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES shipments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  at          TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info',                 -- info | ok | err
  text        TEXT NOT NULL,
  user_id     INTEGER REFERENCES users(id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS shipment_events_ship ON shipment_events(shipment_id);
INSERT INTO shipment_events (shipment_id, at, kind, text, user_id)
  SELECT id, COALESCE(created_at, updated_at, datetime('now', 'localtime')), 'info', 'Livraison créée', user_id FROM shipments;

-- Textes de départ sans le mot « démonstration »
UPDATE tasks SET title = 'Vidéo de présentation du tapis BT 500+ en showroom' WHERE title = 'Vidéo démonstration du tapis BT 500+ en showroom';
UPDATE carriers SET notes = 'Camion FitnessTN : livraison + installation + mise en service.' WHERE notes = 'Camion FitnessTN : livraison + installation + démonstration.';

-- Ventes, dépenses : lignes venant d'un fichier Excel
ALTER TABLE sales ADD COLUMN import_ref TEXT;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sales_import ON sales(import_ref) WHERE import_ref IS NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE expenses ADD COLUMN import_ref TEXT;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS expenses_import ON expenses(import_ref) WHERE import_ref IS NOT NULL;

-- Réparations & service après-vente
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS repairs (
  id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  number       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,                        -- SAV-26-00001
  kind         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'reparation',          -- reparation (payante) | sav (garantie)
  location_id  INTEGER REFERENCES locations(id),
  client_id    INTEGER REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  client_name  TEXT DEFAULT '',
  phone        TEXT DEFAULT '',
  phone2       TEXT DEFAULT '',
  gouvernorat  TEXT DEFAULT '',
  address      TEXT DEFAULT '',
  product_id   INTEGER REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  product      TEXT DEFAULT '',                             -- machine concernée (texte libre)
  issue        TEXT DEFAULT '',                             -- panne décrite par le client
  technician   TEXT DEFAULT '',                             -- réparateur
  status       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'nouveau',             -- nouveau | en_cours | repare | annule
  place        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'domicile',            -- domicile (chez le client) | atelier
  amount       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,                  -- montant facturé (diagnostic, déplacement, réparation), millimes
  paid         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,                  -- montant encaissé, millimes
  appointment  TEXT,                                        -- rendez-vous (aaaa-mm-jj hh:mm)
  received_at  TEXT,                                        -- date de la demande
  done_at      TEXT,                                        -- date de la réparation
  note         TEXT DEFAULT '',
  import_ref   TEXT,
  user_id      INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at   TEXT,
  updated_at   TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS repairs_status ON repairs(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS repairs_phone ON repairs(phone);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS repairs_import ON repairs(import_ref) WHERE import_ref IS NOT NULL;

Chaque ligne devient une vente du showroom de Tunis, numérotée XL-26-…, payée en contre-remboursement si un transporteur est cité (sinon en espèces), sans toucher au stock ni aux caisses. Les livraisons gardent le transporteur, le technicien et les frais. Importez ensuite le fichier « PAIEMENT » : les retours et les montants non reçus seront rapprochés de ces ventes.

Chaque ligne devient une livraison avec son transporteur, son n° de suivi et l’argent à récupérer. « Payé » = argent reçu ; « RETOUR » = retour ; vide = en attente. Une ligne qui correspond à une vente déjà importée (même client, même montant) complète cette vente au lieu d’en créer une autre.

Chaque ligne devient une fiche « Réparations & SAV » (client, machine, panne, réparateur, statut, montant). Les clients sont retrouvés par téléphone ou créés.

  • Administrateur — tout : les deux showrooms, finances et marges, prix d’achat, utilisateurs, paramètres, annulation de ventes, import de catalogue.

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/* ---------- Sessions de caisse ---------- */

function open_session(int $locId): ?array
{
    return one("SELECT * FROM cash_sessions WHERE location_id = ? AND status = 'ouverte' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1", [$locId]);
}

function session_open(int $locId, int $float): int
{
    if (open_session($locId)) throw new RuntimeException('Une session de caisse est déjà ouverte pour ce showroom.');
    $id = insert('cash_sessions', [
        'location_id' => $locId, 'opened_by' => user()['id'] ?? null, 'opened_at' => now(),
        'opening_float' => max(0, $float), 'status' => 'ouverte',
    ]);
    audit('ouverture de caisse', 'session', $id, 'Fond : ' . money($float));
    return $id;
}

/** Totaux d'une session : encaissements par mode, sorties de caisse, espèces attendues. */
function session_totals(array $s): array
{
    $by = [];
    foreach (all('SELECT method, SUM(amount) t, COUNT(*) n FROM payments WHERE session_id = ? GROUP BY method', [$s['id']]) as $r) {
        $by[$r['method']] = (int)$r['t'];
    }
    // Paiements de factures reçus dans cette caisse (espèces)
    $inv = 0;
    foreach (all('SELECT method, SUM(amount) t FROM document_payments WHERE session_id = ? GROUP BY method', [$s['id']]) as $r) {
        $by[$r['method']] = ($by[$r['method']] ?? 0) + (int)$r['t'];
        $inv += (int)$r['t'];
    }
    $cashOut = (int)(val("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM expenses WHERE session_id = ? AND method = 'especes'", [$s['id']]) ?? 0);
    $sales = one("SELECT COUNT(*) n, COALESCE(SUM(total),0) t FROM sales WHERE session_id = ? AND status <> 'annulee'", [$s['id']]);
    $cashIn = $by['especes'] ?? 0;
    return [
        'by_method' => $by,
        'cash_in' => $cashIn,
        'cash_out' => $cashOut,
        'expected_cash' => (int)$s['opening_float'] + $cashIn - $cashOut,
        'sales_count' => (int)$sales['n'],
        'sales_total' => (int)$sales['t'],
        'collected' => array_sum($by),
        'invoices' => $inv,
    ];
}

const DENOMINATIONS = [
    50000 => '50 DT', 20000 => '20 DT', 10000 => '10 DT', 5000 => '5 DT (billet/pièce)', 2000 => '2 DT', 1000 => '1 DT',
    500 => '500 millimes', 200 => '200 millimes', 100 => '100 millimes', 50 => '50 millimes', 20 => '20 millimes', 10 => '10 millimes',
];

/* ---------- Clients ---------- */

function normalize_phone(string $p): string
{
    $d = preg_replace('/\D+/', '', $p);
    if (strlen($d) === 11 && str_starts_with($d, '216')) $d = substr($d, 3);
    if (strlen($d) === 13 && str_starts_with($d, '00216')) $d = substr($d, 5);
    return $d;
}

/** Retrouve (par téléphone) ou crée un client. Retourne son id, ou null si aucun nom/téléphone. */
function client_upsert(array $c): ?int
{
    if (!empty($c['id'])) {
        $id = (int)$c['id'];
        if (!one('SELECT id FROM clients WHERE id = ?', [$id])) throw new RuntimeException('Client introuvable.');
        return $id;
    }
    $name = trim((string)($c['name'] ?? ''));
    $phone = normalize_phone((string)($c['phone'] ?? ''));
    if ($name === '' && $phone === '') return null;
    if ($phone !== '') {
        $ex = one('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE phone = ?', [$phone]);
        if ($ex) {
            $upd = [];
            foreach (['gouvernorat', 'city', 'address'] as $k) {
                if (!empty($c[$k]) && empty($ex[$k])) $upd[$k] = trim((string)$c[$k]);
            }
            if ($upd) update('clients', $upd + ['updated_at' => now()], 'id = ?', [$ex['id']]);
            return (int)$ex['id'];
        }
    }
    return insert('clients', [
        'name' => $name !== '' ? $name : 'Client ' . $phone, 'phone' => $phone,
        'gouvernorat' => trim((string)($c['gouvernorat'] ?? '')), 'city' => trim((string)($c['city'] ?? '')),
        'address' => trim((string)($c['address'] ?? '')), 'source' => (string)($c['source'] ?? ''),
        'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now(),
    ]);
}

/* ---------- Ventes ---------- */

function sale_status(int $total, int $paid): string
{
    return $paid >= $total ? 'payee' : 'partielle';
}

/**
 * Enregistre une vente de caisse. $in : location_id, items[], discount, client{}, source, campaign_id,
 * payments[], note, delivery{}. Retourne ['id' => …, 'number' => …].
 */
function sale_create(array $in): array
{
    $u = user();
    $locId = (int)($in['location_id'] ?? 0);
    $loc = location($locId);
    if (!$loc || !$loc['active']) throw new RuntimeException('Showroom inconnu.');
    if (!can_loc($locId)) throw new RuntimeException('Vous ne pouvez pas encaisser pour ce showroom.');
    $session = open_session($locId);
    if (!$session) throw new RuntimeException('La caisse de ce showroom est fermée : ouvrez une session.');

    $items = [];
    $subtotal = 0;
    $catalog = 0;
    foreach ((array)($in['items'] ?? []) as $it) {
        $qty = (int)($it['qty'] ?? 0);
        if ($qty < 1 || $qty > 999) throw new RuntimeException('Quantité invalide.');
        $unit = parse_money($it['unit_price'] ?? null);
        if ($unit === null || $unit < 0) throw new RuntimeException('Prix invalide.');
        $vat = (float)($it['vat_rate'] ?? setting('vat_rate', 19));
        if (!in_array($vat, [0.0, 7.0, 13.0, 19.0], true)) $vat = (float)setting('vat_rate', 19);
        $pid = !empty($it['product_id']) ? (int)$it['product_id'] : null;
        if ($pid) {
            $p = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [$pid]);
            if (!$p || !$p['active']) throw new RuntimeException('Produit introuvable ou archivé.');
            $list = product_price($p);
            if ($list === 0 && $unit === 0) throw new RuntimeException('« ' . $p['name'] . ' » est sur devis : saisissez son prix.');
            $items[] = ['product_id' => $pid, 'label' => $p['name'], 'qty' => $qty, 'unit_price' => $unit, 'list_price' => $list ?: $unit,
                'unit_cost' => $p['cost'] !== null ? (int)$p['cost'] : null, 'vat_rate' => $vat, 'total' => $unit * $qty,
                'warranty_months' => $p['warranty_months']];
            $catalog += ($list ?: $unit) * $qty;
        } else {
            $label = trim((string)($it['label'] ?? ''));
            if ($label === '') throw new RuntimeException('Libellé manquant pour une ligne libre.');
            $items[] = ['product_id' => null, 'label' => mb_substr($label, 0, 120), 'qty' => $qty, 'unit_price' => $unit, 'list_price' => $unit,
                'unit_cost' => null, 'vat_rate' => $vat, 'total' => $unit * $qty, 'warranty_months' => null];
            $catalog += $unit * $qty;
        }
        $subtotal += $unit * $qty;
    }
    if (!$items) throw new RuntimeException('Le panier est vide.');

    $discount = parse_money($in['discount'] ?? 0) ?? 0;
    if ($discount < 0 || $discount > $subtotal) throw new RuntimeException('Remise invalide.');
    $total = $subtotal - $discount;

    $maxPct = (float)setting('max_discount_pct', 20);
    if ($u['role'] !== 'admin' && $catalog > 0) {
        $pct = ($catalog - $total) / $catalog * 100;
        if ($pct > $maxPct + 0.001) {
            throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Remise totale de %s : le maximum autorisé est %s. Demandez à l’administrateur.', pct($pct, 1), pct($maxPct)));
        }
    }

    $payments = [];
    $paid = 0;
    foreach ((array)($in['payments'] ?? []) as $pm) {
        $method = (string)($pm['method'] ?? '');
        if (!isset(PAY_METHODS[$method]) || $method === 'cod') throw new RuntimeException('Mode de paiement invalide.');
        $amount = parse_money($pm['amount'] ?? null);
        if ($amount === null || $amount <= 0) continue;
        $payments[] = ['method' => $method, 'amount' => $amount, 'reference' => mb_substr(trim((string)($pm['reference'] ?? '')), 0, 80)];
        $paid += $amount;
    }
    if ($paid > $total) throw new RuntimeException('Les paiements dépassent le total : saisissez le montant dû (la monnaie est calculée à part).');

    $client = (array)($in['client'] ?? []);
    $delivery = (array)($in['delivery'] ?? []);
    $hasDelivery = !empty($delivery['enabled']);
    if ($paid < $total && empty($client['id']) && (trim((string)($client['name'] ?? '')) === '' || normalize_phone((string)($client['phone'] ?? '')) === '')) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Reste à payer : le nom et le téléphone du client sont obligatoires.');
    }
    if ($hasDelivery && empty($client['id']) && normalize_phone((string)($client['phone'] ?? $delivery['phone'] ?? '')) === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Livraison : le téléphone du client est obligatoire.');
    }

    $source = (string)($in['source'] ?? '');
    if ($source !== '' && !isset(SOURCES[$source])) $source = 'autre';
    $campaignId = !empty($in['campaign_id']) ? (int)$in['campaign_id'] : null;
    if ($campaignId && !one('SELECT id FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', [$campaignId])) $campaignId = null;

    return tx(function () use ($u, $loc, $locId, $session, $items, $subtotal, $discount, $total, $catalog, $payments, $paid, $client, $delivery, $hasDelivery, $source, $campaignId, $in) {
        if (setting('allow_negative_stock', '1') !== '1') {
            $need = [];
            foreach ($items as $it) if ($it['product_id']) $need[$it['product_id']] = ($need[$it['product_id']] ?? 0) + $it['qty'];
            foreach ($need as $pid => $qty) {
                $have = stock_qty((int)$pid, $locId);
                if ($have < $qty) {
                    $name = val('SELECT name FROM products WHERE id = ?', [$pid]);
                    throw new RuntimeException("Stock insuffisant pour « $name » ($have disponible au showroom).");
                }
            }
        }
        $client['source'] = $source;
        $clientId = client_upsert($client);
        $number = $loc['code'] . '-' . date('y') . '-' . str_pad((string)next_seq('sale:' . $loc['code'] . ':' . date('Y')), 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
        $saleId = insert('sales', [
            'number' => $number, 'location_id' => $locId, 'session_id' => $session['id'], 'user_id' => $u['id'],
            'client_id' => $clientId, 'created_at' => now(), 'subtotal' => $subtotal, 'discount' => $discount,
            'total' => $total, 'paid' => $paid, 'catalog_total' => $catalog, 'status' => sale_status($total, $paid),
            'source' => $source, 'campaign_id' => $campaignId, 'note' => mb_substr(trim((string)($in['note'] ?? '')), 0, 500),
        ]);
        foreach ($items as $it) {
            insert('sale_items', ['sale_id' => $saleId] + $it);
            if ($it['product_id']) stock_change((int)$it['product_id'], $locId, -$it['qty'], 'vente', $number);
        }
        foreach ($payments as $pm) {
            insert('payments', $pm + ['sale_id' => $saleId, 'session_id' => $session['id'], 'location_id' => $locId,
                    'created_at' => now(), 'user_id' => $u['id']]);
        }
        if ($hasDelivery) {
            $c = $clientId ? one('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?', [$clientId]) : [];
            $carrier = !empty($delivery['carrier_id']) ? (int)$delivery['carrier_id'] : null;
            if ($carrier && !one('SELECT id FROM carriers WHERE id = ?', [$carrier])) $carrier = null;
            $cod = parse_money($delivery['cod_amount'] ?? null);
            shipment_create([
                'sale_id' => $saleId, 'client_id' => $clientId, 'location_id' => $locId, 'carrier_id' => $carrier,
                'recipient' => trim((string)($delivery['recipient'] ?? '')) ?: ($c['name'] ?? ''),
                'phone' => normalize_phone((string)($delivery['phone'] ?? '')) ?: ($c['phone'] ?? ''),
                'gouvernorat' => trim((string)($delivery['gouvernorat'] ?? '')) ?: ($c['gouvernorat'] ?? ''),
                'city' => trim((string)($delivery['city'] ?? '')) ?: ($c['city'] ?? ''),
                'address' => trim((string)($delivery['address'] ?? '')) ?: ($c['address'] ?? ''),
                'planned_date' => parse_date($delivery['planned_date'] ?? null),
                'fee' => max(0, parse_money($delivery['fee'] ?? 0) ?? 0),
                'cod_amount' => $cod !== null ? max(0, min($cod, $total - $paid)) : $total - $paid,
                'note' => mb_substr(trim((string)($delivery['note'] ?? '')), 0, 500),
            ]);
        }
        audit('vente', 'sale', $saleId, $number . ' · ' . money($total) . ($paid < $total ? ' · reste ' . money($total - $paid) : ''));
        return ['id' => $saleId, 'number' => $number];
    });
}

/** Encaissement complémentaire (reste à payer, facilité). */
function sale_add_payment(int $saleId, string $method, int $amount, string $reference = ''): void
{
    $s = one('SELECT * FROM sales WHERE id = ?', [$saleId]);
    if (!$s || !can_loc((int)$s['location_id'])) throw new RuntimeException('Vente introuvable.');
    if ($s['status'] === 'annulee') throw new RuntimeException('Cette vente est annulée.');
    if (!isset(PAY_METHODS[$method])) throw new RuntimeException('Mode de paiement invalide.');
    $rest = (int)$s['total'] - (int)$s['paid'];
    if ($amount <= 0 || $amount > $rest) throw new RuntimeException('Montant invalide (reste à payer : ' . money($rest) . ').');
    $session = $method === 'cod' ? null : open_session((int)$s['location_id']);
    if ($method === 'especes' && !$session) throw new RuntimeException('Pour un encaissement en espèces, ouvrez d’abord la caisse du showroom.');
    tx(function () use ($s, $method, $amount, $reference, $session) {
        insert('payments', [
            'sale_id' => $s['id'], 'session_id' => $session['id'] ?? null, 'location_id' => $s['location_id'],
            'created_at' => now(), 'method' => $method, 'amount' => $amount, 'reference' => mb_substr($reference, 0, 80),
            'user_id' => user()['id'] ?? null,
        ]);
        $paid = (int)$s['paid'] + $amount;
        update('sales', ['paid' => $paid, 'status' => sale_status((int)$s['total'], $paid)], 'id = ?', [$s['id']]);
        audit('encaissement', 'sale', $s['id'], $s['number'] . ' · ' . PAY_METHODS[$method] . ' ' . money($amount));
    });
}

/** Annulation (admin) : remise en stock, remboursement tracé, livraisons annulées. */
function sale_cancel(int $saleId, string $reason): void
{
    $s = one('SELECT * FROM sales WHERE id = ?', [$saleId]);
    if (!$s) throw new RuntimeException('Vente introuvable.');
    if ($s['status'] === 'annulee') throw new RuntimeException('Vente déjà annulée.');
    if (trim($reason) === '') throw new RuntimeException('Indiquez le motif de l’annulation.');
    tx(function () use ($s, $reason) {
        foreach (all('SELECT * FROM sale_items WHERE sale_id = ? AND product_id IS NOT NULL', [$s['id']]) as $it) {
            stock_change((int)$it['product_id'], (int)$s['location_id'], (int)$it['qty'], 'annulation', $s['number'], $reason);
        }
        $session = open_session((int)$s['location_id']);
        foreach (all('SELECT method, SUM(amount) t FROM payments WHERE sale_id = ? GROUP BY method HAVING SUM(amount) <> 0', [$s['id']]) as $p) {
            insert('payments', [
                'sale_id' => $s['id'], 'session_id' => $p['method'] === 'cod' ? null : ($session['id'] ?? null),
                'location_id' => $s['location_id'], 'created_at' => now(), 'method' => $p['method'],
                'amount' => -(int)$p['t'], 'reference' => 'Remboursement (annulation)', 'user_id' => user()['id'] ?? null,
            ]);
        }
        update('sales', ['status' => 'annulee', 'paid' => 0, 'cancelled_at' => now(), 'cancelled_by' => user()['id'] ?? null,
            'cancel_reason' => mb_substr($reason, 0, 300)], 'id = ?', [$s['id']]);
        q("UPDATE shipments SET status = 'annulee', updated_at = ? WHERE sale_id = ? AND status IN ('a_preparer','en_cours')", [now(), $s['id']]);
        audit('annulation de vente', 'sale', $s['id'], $s['number'] . ' · ' . $reason);
    });
}

/* ---------- Livraisons ---------- */

/**
 * Crée une livraison. $items : [['product_id' => …, 'label' => …, 'qty' => …]] ; sans lignes et avec une vente liée,
 * la marchandise de la vente est reprise automatiquement.
 */
function shipment_create(array $d, ?array $items = null, string $eventText = 'Livraison créée'): int
{
    $d['number'] = 'LIV-' . date('y') . '-' . str_pad((string)next_seq('ship:' . date('Y')), 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
    $d += ['status' => 'a_preparer', 'user_id' => user()['id'] ?? null, 'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now()];
    $d += ['holder' => ship_holder_for_status($d['status'])];
    $id = insert('shipments', $d);
    if ($items === null && !empty($d['sale_id'])) {
        $items = all('SELECT product_id, label, qty FROM sale_items WHERE sale_id = ?', [$d['sale_id']]);
    }
    shipment_set_items($id, $items ?? []);
    $carrierName = !empty($d['carrier_id']) ? (string)val('SELECT name FROM carriers WHERE id = ?', [$d['carrier_id']]) : '';
    shipment_event($id, $eventText . ($carrierName !== '' ? ' · transporteur : ' . $carrierName : ''), 'info', $d['created_at']);
    audit('livraison créée', 'shipment', $id, $d['number']);
    return $id;
}

/** Remplace la marchandise d'une livraison. */
function shipment_set_items(int $shipmentId, array $items): void
{
    q('DELETE FROM shipment_items WHERE shipment_id = ?', [$shipmentId]);
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $label = trim((string)($it['label'] ?? ''));
        $pid = !empty($it['product_id']) ? (int)$it['product_id'] : null;
        if ($pid && $label === '') $label = (string)val('SELECT name FROM products WHERE id = ?', [$pid]);
        if ($label === '') continue;
        insert('shipment_items', ['shipment_id' => $shipmentId, 'product_id' => $pid, 'label' => mb_substr($label, 0, 160), 'qty' => max(1, min(999, (int)($it['qty'] ?? 1)))]);
    }
}

function shipment_items(int $shipmentId): array
{
    return all('SELECT * FROM shipment_items WHERE shipment_id = ? ORDER BY id', [$shipmentId]);
}

/** « 2 × BT 200+ · Huile lubrifiant » */
function shipment_items_text(array $items, int $max = 3): string
{
    $parts = [];
    foreach (array_slice($items, 0, $max) as $it) $parts[] = ((int)$it['qty'] > 1 ? (int)$it['qty'] . ' × ' : '') . $it['label'];
    if (count($items) > $max) $parts[] = '+' . (count($items) - $max);
    return implode(' · ', $parts);
}

/** Ajoute une étape à l'historique d'une livraison. */
function shipment_event(int $shipmentId, string $text, string $kind = 'info', ?string $at = null): void
{
    insert('shipment_events', ['shipment_id' => $shipmentId, 'at' => $at ?: now(), 'kind' => $kind, 'text' => mb_substr($text, 0, 300), 'user_id' => user()['id'] ?? null]);
}

/** Où se trouve normalement la marchandise pour un statut donné. */
function ship_holder_for_status(string $status): string
{
    return ['en_cours' => 'transporteur', 'livree' => 'client', 'retour' => 'retour'][$status] ?? 'depart';
}

/** Libellé « Chez le transporteur (TPS) ». */
function ship_holder_label(array $sh, ?string $carrier = null): string
{
    $label = SHIP_HOLDERS[$sh['holder'] ?? 'depart'] ?? '';
    $extra = trim((string)($sh['holder_note'] ?? ''));
    if ($extra === '' && ($sh['holder'] ?? '') === 'transporteur' && $carrier) $extra = $carrier;
    if ($extra === '' && ($sh['holder'] ?? '') === 'technicien' && !empty($sh['technician'])) $extra = $sh['technician'];
    return $label . ($extra !== '' ? ' — ' . $extra : '');
}

/** Change le statut (et, sauf précision, le lieu de la marchandise) en gardant une trace dans l'historique. */
function shipment_set_status(array $sh, string $status, ?string $holder = null, string $note = ''): void
{
    if (!isset(SHIP_STATUS[$status])) throw new RuntimeException('Statut invalide.');
    $holder = $holder !== null && isset(SHIP_HOLDERS[$holder]) ? $holder : ($status !== $sh['status'] ? ship_holder_for_status($status) : $sh['holder']);
    $data = ['status' => $status, 'holder' => $holder, 'updated_at' => now(),
        'delivered_at' => $status === 'livree' ? ($sh['delivered_at'] ?: now()) : null];
    if ($holder !== $sh['holder']) $data['holder_note'] = '';
    update('shipments', $data, 'id = ?', [$sh['id']]);
    if ($status !== $sh['status']) {
        shipment_event((int)$sh['id'], SHIP_STATUS[$status] . ($note !== '' ? ' · ' . $note : ''), $status === 'livree' ? 'ok' : ($status === 'retour' || $status === 'annulee' ? 'err' : 'info'));
    } elseif ($holder !== $sh['holder']) {
        shipment_event((int)$sh['id'], 'Marchandise : ' . mb_strtolower(SHIP_HOLDERS[$holder]));
    }
}

/** Contre-remboursement encaissé par le transporteur : crée le paiement sur la vente liée. */
function shipment_collect(array $sh): void
{
    if ($sh['cod_collected']) return;
    tx(function () use ($sh) {
        if ($sh['sale_id'] && (int)$sh['cod_amount'] > 0) {
            $s = one('SELECT * FROM sales WHERE id = ?', [$sh['sale_id']]);
            if ($s && $s['status'] !== 'annulee') {
                $amount = min((int)$sh['cod_amount'], (int)$s['total'] - (int)$s['paid']);
                if ($amount > 0) sale_add_payment((int)$s['id'], 'cod', $amount, $sh['number']);
            }
        }
        update('shipments', ['cod_collected' => 1, 'updated_at' => now()], 'id = ?', [$sh['id']]);
        if ((int)$sh['cod_amount'] > 0) shipment_event((int)$sh['id'], 'Argent récupéré : ' . money($sh['cod_amount']), 'ok');
    });
}

function sale_items(int $saleId): array
{
    return all('SELECT si.*, p.sku, p.image, p.image_url, p.family FROM sale_items si LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id WHERE si.sale_id = ? ORDER BY si.id', [$saleId]);
}

/** Décomposition HT / TVA d'une vente (remise globale répartie au prorata). */
function sale_vat(array $sale, array $items): array
{
    $sub = max(1, (int)$sale['subtotal']);
    $ratio = ((int)$sale['total']) / $sub;
    $rates = [];
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $ttc = (int)round((int)$it['total'] * $ratio);
        $rate = (float)$it['vat_rate'];
        $rates[(string)$rate] = ($rates[(string)$rate] ?? 0) + $ttc;
    }
    $out = [];
    foreach ($rates as $rate => $ttc) {
        $ht = (int)round($ttc / (1 + (float)$rate / 100));
        $out[] = ['rate' => (float)$rate, 'ttc' => $ttc, 'ht' => $ht, 'vat' => $ttc - $ht];
    }
    return $out;
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/* ---------- Réparations & service après-vente ---------- */

function repair_number(): string
{
    return 'SAV-' . date('y') . '-' . str_pad((string)next_seq('repair:' . date('Y')), 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
}

function repair_load(int $id): ?array
{
    $r = one('SELECT * FROM repairs WHERE id = ?', [$id]);
    return $r && can_loc($r['location_id'] !== null ? (int)$r['location_id'] : null) ? $r : null;
}

/**
 * Crée ou met à jour une fiche. $in : client_name, phone, phone2, address, gouvernorat, product, product_id, issue, kind,
 * technician, status, place, amount (millimes), paid (millimes), appointment, received_at, note, location_id, import_ref.
 */
function repair_save(array $in, ?array $old = null): int
{
    $status = isset(REPAIR_STATUS[$in['status'] ?? '']) ? $in['status'] : ($old['status'] ?? 'nouveau');
    $phone = normalize_phone((string)($in['phone'] ?? ''));
    $name = mb_substr(trim((string)($in['client_name'] ?? '')), 0, 120);
    $address = mb_substr(trim((string)($in['address'] ?? '')), 0, 300);
    $gouv = trim((string)($in['gouvernorat'] ?? ''));
    if ($gouv === '' || !in_array($gouv, GOUVERNORATS, true)) $gouv = guess_gouvernorat($address);
    $data = [
        'kind' => isset(REPAIR_KINDS[$in['kind'] ?? '']) ? $in['kind'] : 'reparation',
        'client_name' => $name, 'phone' => $phone, 'phone2' => normalize_phone((string)($in['phone2'] ?? '')),
        'gouvernorat' => $gouv, 'address' => $address,
        'product_id' => !empty($in['product_id']) ? (int)$in['product_id'] : null,
        'product' => mb_substr(trim((string)($in['product'] ?? '')), 0, 160),
        'issue' => mb_substr(trim((string)($in['issue'] ?? '')), 0, 500),
        'technician' => mb_substr(trim((string)($in['technician'] ?? '')), 0, 60),
        'status' => $status,
        'place' => isset(REPAIR_PLACES[$in['place'] ?? '']) ? $in['place'] : 'domicile',
        'amount' => max(0, (int)($in['amount'] ?? 0)), 'paid' => max(0, (int)($in['paid'] ?? 0)),
        'appointment' => ($in['appointment'] ?? '') !== '' ? str_replace('T', ' ', substr((string)$in['appointment'], 0, 16)) : null,
        'received_at' => parse_date($in['received_at'] ?? null),
        'note' => mb_substr(trim((string)($in['note'] ?? '')), 0, 1000),
        'updated_at' => now(),
    ];
    if ($data['product_id'] && $data['product'] === '') $data['product'] = (string)val('SELECT name FROM products WHERE id = ?', [$data['product_id']]);
    if ($status === 'repare') $data['done_at'] = $old['done_at'] ?? ($in['done_at'] ?? null) ?: today();
    elseif ($old && $old['status'] === 'repare') $data['done_at'] = null;
    if ($name === '' && $phone === '' && $data['product'] === '' && $data['issue'] === '' && $address === '') throw new RuntimeException('Fiche vide : indiquez au moins le client, le téléphone, l’adresse ou la panne.');

    // Client : retrouvé par téléphone ou créé (fiche client = historique achats + réparations)
    if ($phone !== '' || $name !== '') {
        $data['client_id'] = client_upsert(['name' => $name, 'phone' => $phone, 'address' => $address, 'gouvernorat' => $gouv,
            'source' => $old ? '' : (string)($in['source'] ?? '')]);
        if ($name === '' && $data['client_id']) $data['client_name'] = (string)val('SELECT name FROM clients WHERE id = ?', [$data['client_id']]);
    }
    if ($old) {
        update('repairs', $data, 'id = ?', [$old['id']]);
        if ($old['status'] !== $status) audit('réparation : ' . REPAIR_STATUS[$status], 'repair', $old['id'], $old['number']);
        return (int)$old['id'];
    }
    $data += [
        'number' => repair_number(), 'location_id' => $in['location_id'] ?? null, 'import_ref' => $in['import_ref'] ?? null,
        'user_id' => user()['id'] ?? null, 'created_at' => $in['created_at'] ?? now(),
    ];
    $id = insert('repairs', $data);
    audit('réparation créée', 'repair', $id, $data['number'] . ' · ' . ($data['client_name'] ?: $phone));
    return $id;
}

/** Lien WhatsApp vers le client, avec un message adapté au statut. */
function repair_whatsapp(array $r): string
{
    $p = normalize_phone((string)$r['phone']);
    if (strlen($p) !== 8) return '';
    $machine = $r['product'] ?: 'votre machine';
    $msg = match ($r['status']) {
        'repare' => "Bonjour, ici FitnessTN. Bonne nouvelle : $machine est réparé(e)." . ((int)$r['amount'] > (int)$r['paid'] ? ' Montant : ' . money((int)$r['amount'] - (int)$r['paid']) . '.' : '') . ' Merci pour votre confiance !',
        'en_cours' => "Bonjour, ici FitnessTN. Votre demande de réparation ($machine) est en cours. Notre technicien vous tient informé(e).",
        default => "Bonjour, ici FitnessTN, au sujet de votre demande de réparation ($machine). Quand notre technicien peut-il passer ?",
    };
    return 'https://wa.me/216' . $p . '?text=' . rawurlencode($msg);
}

function repair_tone(string $status): string
{
    return ['nouveau' => 'info', 'en_cours' => 'warn', 'repare' => 'ok', 'annule' => 'err'][$status] ?? '';
}

-- ERP FitnessTN : schéma SQLite. Tous les montants sont en millimes (1 DT = 1000).

CREATE TABLE settings (
  key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE counters (
  key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
