<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/*
 * Lecture des classeurs Excel (.xlsx) sans dépendance : un .xlsx est une archive zip de fichiers XML.
 * ZipArchive est utilisé s'il est disponible, sinon un petit lecteur zip intégré (zlib suffit).
 */

function xlsx_is_file(string $file): bool
{
    $h = @fopen($file, 'rb');
    if (!$h) return false;
    $sig = (string)fread($h, 4);
    fclose($h);
    return $sig === "PK\x03\x04";
}

/** Contenu des entrées d'une archive zip dont le nom vérifie $accept (callable ou null = tout). */
function zip_read_entries(string $file, ?callable $accept = null): array
{
    $out = [];
    if (class_exists('ZipArchive')) {
        $z = new ZipArchive();
        if ($z->open($file) === true) {
            for ($i = 0; $i < $z->numFiles; $i++) {
                $name = (string)$z->getNameIndex($i);
                if ($accept && !$accept($name)) continue;
                $data = $z->getFromIndex($i);
                if ($data !== false) $out[$name] = $data;
            }
            $z->close();
            return $out;
        }
    }
    $raw = (string)file_get_contents($file);
    $eocd = strrpos($raw, "PK\x05\x06");
    if ($eocd === false) throw new RuntimeException('Fichier Excel illisible (archive zip incomplète).');
    $cd = unpack('ventries/Vsize/Voffset', substr($raw, $eocd + 10, 10));
    $pos = $cd['offset'];
    for ($i = 0; $i < $cd['entries']; $i++) {
        if (substr($raw, $pos, 4) !== "PK\x01\x02") break;
        $h = unpack('vmethod/x8/Vcsize/Vsize/vnlen/velen/vclen/x8/Vlocal', substr($raw, $pos + 10, 36));
        $name = substr($raw, $pos + 46, $h['nlen']);
        $pos += 46 + $h['nlen'] + $h['elen'] + $h['clen'];
        if ($accept && !$accept($name)) continue;
        $lh = unpack('vnlen/velen', substr($raw, $h['local'] + 26, 4));
        $data = substr($raw, $h['local'] + 30 + $lh['nlen'] + $lh['elen'], $h['csize']);
        if ($h['method'] === 8) $data = @gzinflate($data);
        elseif ($h['method'] !== 0) $data = false;
        if ($data !== false) $out[$name] = $data;
    }
    return $out;
}

/** « AB » -> 27 (colonnes numérotées à partir de 1). */
function xlsx_col_index(string $letters): int
{
    $n = 0;
    foreach (str_split(strtoupper($letters)) as $c) $n = $n * 26 + (ord($c) - 64);
    return $n;
}

/**
 * Lit toutes les feuilles. Retourne [['name' => 'Feuil1', 'rows' => [n° de ligne => [n° de colonne => texte]]], …].
 * Les valeurs restent du texte brut (les dates Excel sont des numéros de série, ex. 46078).
 */
function xlsx_read(string $file): array
{
    $files = zip_read_entries($file, fn(string $n) => str_starts_with($n, 'xl/') && str_ends_with($n, '.xml') || str_ends_with($n, '.rels'));
    if (!isset($files['xl/workbook.xml'])) throw new RuntimeException('Ce fichier n’est pas un classeur Excel (.xlsx).');
    $prev = libxml_use_internal_errors(true);
    $strings = [];
    if (isset($files['xl/sharedStrings.xml'])) {
        $sx = simplexml_load_string($files['xl/sharedStrings.xml']);
        if ($sx) foreach ($sx->si as $si) {
            if (isset($si->t)) { $strings[] = (string)$si->t; continue; }
            $t = '';
            foreach ($si->r as $r) $t .= (string)$r->t;
            $strings[] = $t;
        }
    }
    $targets = [];
    if (isset($files['xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'])) {
        $rels = simplexml_load_string($files['xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels']);
        if ($rels) foreach ($rels->Relationship as $r) $targets[(string)$r['Id']] = (string)$r['Target'];
    }
    $wb = simplexml_load_string($files['xl/workbook.xml']);
    $sheets = [];
    $i = 0;
    foreach ($wb->sheets->sheet ?? [] as $sh) {
        $i++;
        $rid = (string)($sh->attributes('http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships')['id'] ?? '');
        $target = $targets[$rid] ?? "worksheets/sheet$i.xml";
        $path = str_starts_with($target, '/') ? substr($target, 1) : 'xl/' . ltrim($target, './');
        if (!isset($files[$path])) continue;
        $xml = simplexml_load_string($files[$path]);
        if (!$xml) continue;
        $rows = [];
        foreach ($xml->sheetData->row ?? [] as $row) {
            $rn = (int)$row['r'];
            $cells = [];
            $auto = 0;
            foreach ($row->c as $c) {
                $ref = (string)$c['r'];
                $col = $ref !== '' && preg_match('/^([A-Z]+)/', $ref, $m) ? xlsx_col_index($m[1]) : ++$auto;
                $auto = $col;
                $type = (string)$c['t'];
                if ($type === 'inlineStr') {
                    $v = isset($c->is->t) ? (string)$c->is->t : '';
                    if ($v === '' && isset($c->is->r)) foreach ($c->is->r as $r) $v .= (string)$r->t;
                } else {
                    $v = isset($c->v) ? (string)$c->v : '';
                    if ($type === 's') $v = $strings[(int)$v] ?? '';
                    elseif ($type === 'b') $v = $v === '1' ? 'VRAI' : 'FAUX';
                }
                $v = trim(str_replace(["\u{00A0}", "\r"], [' ', ''], $v));
                if ($v !== '') $cells[$col] = $v;
            }
            if ($cells) $rows[$rn] = $cells;
        }
        $sheets[] = ['name' => trim((string)$sh['name']), 'rows' => $rows];
    }
    libxml_use_internal_errors($prev);
    return $sheets;
}

/** Numéro de série Excel (46078) ou date écrite -> aaaa-mm-jj, ou null. */
function xlsx_date($v): ?string
{
    $s = trim((string)$v);
    if ($s === '') return null;
    if (preg_match('/^\d{5}(\.\d+)?$/', $s)) {
        $d = gmdate('Y-m-d', (int)round(((float)$s - 25569) * 86400));
        return (int)substr($d, 0, 4) >= 2000 && (int)substr($d, 0, 4) <= 2100 ? $d : null;
    }
    return parse_date($s);
}

/** Première feuille d'un .xlsx au format de csv_read_file() (en-têtes = première ligne non vide). */
function xlsx_as_csv(string $file): array
{
    $sheets = xlsx_read($file);
    $rows = $sheets[0]['rows'] ?? [];
    if (!$rows) return ['headers' => [], 'labels' => [], 'rows' => [], 'delimiter' => 'xlsx'];
    $headerLine = (int)array_key_first($rows);
    $head = $rows[$headerLine];
    $max = max(array_keys($head));
    $labels = [];
    for ($c = 1; $c <= $max; $c++) $labels[] = trim((string)($head[$c] ?? ''));
    $headers = array_map('slug_key', $labels);
    $out = [];
    foreach ($rows as $n => $cells) {
        if ($n <= $headerLine) continue;
        $row = [];
        foreach ($headers as $i => $h) {
            if ($h === '') continue;
            $row[$h] = (string)($cells[$i + 1] ?? '');
        }
        $row['__line'] = $n;
        $out[] = $row;
    }
    return ['headers' => $headers, 'labels' => $labels, 'rows' => $out, 'delimiter' => 'xlsx'];
}

    $id = doc_save($extra + ['type' => $type, 'location_id' => 1, 'client' => $client, 'date' => $day,
        'due_date' => date('Y-m-d', strtotime("$day +15 days")), 'items' => $items, 'timbre' => true,
        'terms' => 'Acompte de 30 % à la commande, solde à la livraison', 'transport' => 'Livraison et installation incluses', 'warranty' => 'Selon le produit']);
    q('UPDATE documents SET created_at = ? WHERE id = ?', ["$day 10:00:00", $id]);
    return $doc($id);
};
if ($big && $small) {
    $inv2 = $mk('facture', $hotel, [$line($small[2 % count($small)], 6)], 40, ['stock' => true]);

    $mk('facture', $gym, [$line($small[3 % count($small)], 4)], 35);
    $mk('devis', ['name' => 'Club Sportif El Menzah', 'phone' => '73 000 333'], [$line($big[3 % count($big)], 1)], 25);
    $q1 = $mk('devis', $gym, [$line($big[0], 3, 5), $line($big[1 % count($big)], 2, 5), $line($small[0], 10)], 12);
    doc_set_status($q1, 'envoye');

    $inv = $doc(doc_copy($doc((int)$q1['id']), 'facture', true));
    doc_add_payment($inv, 'virement', intdiv((int)$inv['net'] * 3, 10000) * 1000, 'Acompte — virement', date('Y-m-d', strtotime('-9 days')));
    doc_set_status($mk('devis', $hotel, [$line($big[2 % count($big)], 4), $line($small[1 % count($small)], 8)], 3), 'envoye');
}

<h2 class=""font-heavy"">NordicTrack T Series 8 Treadmill</h2>
<div class=""text-templates"">
<div class=""mb-5 row"">
<div class=""col-12 col-md-6"">
<h3 class=""mt-4 mt-md-0 text-center font-weight-bold"">YOUR PACE. YOUR HILL. YOUR RUN.</h3>
<div>

The T Series 8 is a solid folding treadmill that doesn't take up a permanent footprint. Train, fold it up with the EasyLift™ Assist, and the room is yours again. At 51 x 152 cm, the belt is a decent size for walking, jogging, and steady runs.

The SelectFlex™ cushioning is a feature worth knowing about. You can dial it between soft and firm depending on what you're doing - softer for walking or recovery days, firmer when you want something closer to road running. It's a small adjustment that makes a real difference over longer sessions.

Connect your own phone or tablet to the device shelf and use iFIT directly from there. The machine adjusts speed and incline automatically to follow your trainer, so you're not constantly reaching for buttons. With SmartAdjust™, those settings adapt over time based on how you're actually performing. Add a Bluetooth heart rate monitor and ActivePulse™ keeps you in the right training zone throughout.

</div>
</div>
<div>
<div class=""product attribute description active"" data-mage-init=""{"collapsible":{"openedState":"active","active":false}}"" data-collapsible=""true"" data-mercure-processed=""true"">
<div data-role=""content"" aria-hidden=""false"">

</div>

<?php
// Création de la base dans le navigateur (produits du site + ventes d'exemple des 30 derniers jours).
define('FTN_NO_SESSION', true);
putenv('FTN_DB=/www/data/erp.sqlite');
putenv('FTN_SEED_PASSWORD=demo2026');
foreach (['/www/data/sessions', '/www/data/tmp', '/www/assets/img/uploads'] as $d) if (!is_dir($d)) mkdir($d, 0777, true);
require '/www/tests/demo_seed.php';
q('UPDATE users SET initial_password = 0');
// Mots de passe propres à chaque compte de la version en ligne (publics : ils ne servent que dans ce navigateur).
foreach (['admin' => 'ftn-3a44ca', 'tunis' => 'ftn-cdc467', 'nabeul' => 'ftn-14509e', 'marketing' => 'ftn-6473e3', 'livreur' => 'ftn-76b68c'] as $u => $pw) {
    q('UPDATE users SET password_hash = ? WHERE username = ?', [password_hash($pw, PASSWORD_DEFAULT), $u]);
}
